30:5129.name: FilterSkillListByMP
30:5129.note: wBattleActor selects the actor; its MP word is at wD8DF + 2 * actor. For each of the 8 skill numbers in wC0A0 it loads the record (LoadSkillRecordPart) and keeps the number only when byte 0 of the record is below that MP word; otherwise it writes $FF to that slot. The comparison is strict: a skill whose cost equals the MP is dropped. Executed on the emulator for MP 0-40 against the ROM's costs (E-0048)

00:3F47.name: QueuedActionMatches
00:3F47.note: Z set when A equals the queued action (wQueuedActionId, wDAAC) or is its partner in one of the pairs $34-$AD, $35-$AE, $6A-$CC, $A1-$CF, $8F-$AA (the pairs are symmetric); Z clear otherwise. A and BC are kept (E-0049)

32:529E.name: CheckActorStatusAndFoeTargets
32:529E.note: returns carry set when the action may proceed, clear when refused. Refused with D = 3 when bit 0 of the actor's status byte 1 (wD80D + 9 * actor) is set; with D = 4 when bit 3 of the side flag (wD80A for slots 0-3, wD80B for 4-7) is set. Otherwise, when wDA53[actor] >= 2 and wCFF2 = $12, the three opposite slots are scanned: an absent slot is skipped, a present slot without bit 1 or 5 of its status byte 2 allows the action, and if every present one has them the refusal is D = 7 (E-0049)

32:5303.name: CheckActorStatusBit7AndFoeBit6
32:5303.note: carry set = may proceed, clear = refused. Refused with D = 5 when bit 7 of the actor's status byte 1 (wD80D + 9 * actor) is set; otherwise when wDA53[actor] >= 2 the three opposite slots are scanned for a present slot whose status byte 2 (wD80E + 9 * slot) has bit 6 clear (allowed), and if every present one has bit 6 set the refusal is D = 7 (E-0049)

32:534A.name: CheckActorStatusBit6
32:534A.note: carry set = may proceed; clear with D = 6 when bit 6 of the actor's status byte 1 (wD80D + 9 * actor) is set (E-0049)

36:490F.name: ResolveStepAdvanceSubPhase
36:490F.note: resolve step $0F: increments wBattleSubPhase and sets wBattleResolveStep to 0 (E-0050)

36:433F.name: ActionIs91AndStatusBit6Set
36:433F.note: Z set when wBattleActionId = $91 and bit 6 of the actor's status byte 3 (wD80F + 9 * actor) is set; Z clear otherwise (A is $40 or 0 for $91, the comparison result otherwise). Used by RunBattleResolveStep_Case02 (E-0050)

36:431F.name: ResolveStepCallEffect82
36:431F.note: resolve step $02: advances wBattleResolveStep; when wDABD is non-zero and wDAB2 is zero and ActionIs91AndStatusBit6Set is not set, it stores $82 in wDAD2 and farcalls 3A:4001. When wDABD is zero or wDAB2 is non-zero it continues as ResolveStepFlagBit7Effect; when ActionIs91AndStatusBit6Set is set it returns (E-0050)

36:4356.name: ResolveStepFlagBit7Effect
36:4356.note: resolve step $03: advances wBattleResolveStep. When wBattleTarget is present (Func_036_7F3C does not set carry), wCFF4 bit 6 is set, and the target's wD854 byte has bit 7 set, it farcalls 3A:6EE5 with D = $35, calls Func_036_4FD1 and queues sound $84; otherwise it goes on to case 4 (E-0050)

36:48DE.name: ResolveStepBranchOnAction
36:48DE.note: resolve step $0B: wBattleActionId $82 jumps to 36:4A9D; $83, $84 and $B3 jump to 36:4B16; any other action advances wBattleResolveStep and returns (E-0050)

32:5EAB.name: ResolveStep0EEffect
32:5EAB.note: resolve step $0E runs this through wBattleSubStep (wCFCC): ten cases, 0-9. Case 0 branches on wBattleActionId: $15 and $20 to Func_032_5F20, $3B to Func_032_5F3B, $5F to Func_032_5F63, $60 to Func_032_5FAE, $61 to Func_032_5FF8, $6D to Func_032_5F35; the other actions and cases 1-9 are not yet read (E-0051)

36:458E.name: ResolveStepChanceRoll
36:458E.note: resolve step $05: advances wBattleResolveStep. With wCFF4 bits 3-4 both clear it continues into case 6. Bit 4 with the actor's status byte 1 bit 2 set continues into case 6. With wCFF4 bit 3 set and wD854 bit 0 (target) and status byte 1 bit 3 (actor) both clear, it rolls RollWC5E7BelowChance: on success it sets bit 7 of the actor's status byte 2 (wD80E), calls Func_036_7E6C, shows message $9C (carry) or $9D through 3A:7193, queues sound $83 and advances the step again; on failure, or when bit 3 is clear, it clears that bit (E-0052)

36:4918.name: RollWC5E7BelowChance
36:4918.note: farcalls RunBattleResolveStep_Case05_Sub01_Sub01 (not read) and returns the comparison of wC5E7 with hFFC6 (taken as 4 when hFFC6 is 3): carry set when wC5E7 is below that value (E-0052)

36:4025.name: ResolveStepBegin
36:4025.note: resolve step $00: advances wBattleResolveStep and clears wBattleSubStep. When wDABD is zero, wCFF3 bit 7 is set, the target is present and bit 5 of the target's wD854 byte is set, it farcalls RunBattleResolveStep_Case00_Sub01 (not read), stores the result in wC971 when it is not $FF, shows message $33 and returns; otherwise it clears that bit and continues into ResolveStepTargetAndSubEffects (E-0053)

36:4077.name: ResolveStepTargetAndSubEffects
36:4077.note: resolve step $01: dispatches on wBattleSubStep to two cases. Case 0 (RunBattleResolveStep_Table2_Case00) may redirect wBattleTarget and shows message $CB, then selects one of four sub-effects by wCFF3 bits 7, 4 and 6 (RunBattleResolveStep_Table2_Case00_Sub01-Sub04, not read); case 1 (36:4127) follows (E-0053)

36:4603.name: ResolveStepActionEffect
36:4603.note: resolve step $06: advances wBattleResolveStep, then calls DispatchActionEffectTable for wBattleActionId (E-0053)

36:6717.name: DispatchActionEffectTable
36:6717.note: jumps to the routine whose 16-bit address is at 36:6726 + 2 * wBattleActionId (the same JumpToHL idiom as CallInBank). The table has 240 entries (ids 0-239) and ends at $6906, where the first effect routine starts; the routines are named ActionEffect_<skill> after the skills that use them (E-0053, E-0084)

36:4776.name: ResolveStepSoundWaitAndMessage
36:4776.note: resolve step $08: for action $CD it returns while the sound channels in wDC20 are busy (wSoundChannelSlots and wDC20 not both $FF). Otherwise it advances the step twice, updates bit 4 or 6 of wDAC0 from wBattleDamageLo/Hi and wD873 when wDAC0 bit 5 is set, and for action $CF rewinds the step while wDAC0 bit 4 is set and wDABA is zero. It then stores $40 or $41 in wDAD2, farcalls 3A:4001 and 3A:5762 (E-0053)

36:47F1.name: ResolveStepMessage13AndSound
36:47F1.note: resolve step $09: advances wBattleResolveStep, stores $13 in wDAD2, farcalls 3A:4001 and queues sound effect $85 (E-0053)

36:4908.name: ResolveStep0ECallEffect
36:4908.note: resolve step $0E: farcalls ResolveStep0EEffect in bank $32 (E-0053)

36:438A.name: ResolveStepEffectChecks
36:438A.note: resolve step $04: runs RunBattleResolveStep_Case04_Sub01 (returns on action $35) and, when the target is present, advances the step. Then it selects one of several effects from wCFF4 bits 1, 6 and wCFF3 bits 7 and 0 and the status bytes of the actor and target: messages $66, $68 and $D2 (with sound $84) and calls to RunBattleResolveStep_Case04_Sub03 when the roll is below a threshold. The threshold for the roll comes from the actor's AGL minus the target's AGL, in bands of $320, $258, $190, $C8 and $64 (values $80 down to $01); the roll is AdvanceRandom's wC5E7 (E-0054)

36:460B.name: ResolveStepComputeDamage
36:460B.note: resolve step $07: waits for the sound channels in wDC20 when the actor's wD80E bit 7 is set; advances the step; then works on the damage in wBattleDamageLo/Hi and wD873: doubles it for several status bits (wD80D bit 2, wD810 bits 0 and 4 with wCFF3 and wCFF4), rerolls it from the actor's ATK through Func_036_4930 when wCFF4 bit 3 and wD80E bit 7 are set, adds half again for wD854 bit 6, and halves or doubles it on the target's wD813 and wD812 bits (E-0054)

36:4FD1.name: SetSubPhase2AndRestartResolve
36:4FD1.note: for action $CC clears bits 0-1 of the actor's wD810 byte when bits 2-3 equal 4; for an action in $D0-$E3 it farcalls Func_0A3_413F first. Then it sets wBattleSubPhase to 2 and clears wBattleResolveStep (E-0055)

36:5009.name: SetSubPhase3AndRestartResolve
36:5009.note: sets wBattleSubPhase to 3 and clears wBattleResolveStep (E-0055)

3A:7193.name: ShowBattleText
3A:7193.note: D = message index. If the 16-bit entry at Data_03A_71B4 + 2 * D is non-zero it is called first through Func_000_000B (a per-message routine, not read). Then it stores D in wStringIndex, 1 in wStringCategory and farcalls BeginStringDisplay_Bank2F: the battle text of bank $2F, category 1 (E-0056)

3A:6EE5.name: ShowBattleTextCategory0
3A:6EE5.note: D = message index. The same as ShowBattleText, but it stores 0 in wStringCategory: the entry at Data_03A_6F06 + 2 * D is called first when non-zero, then BeginStringDisplay_Bank2F shows category 0 (E-0056)

3A:4001.name: SelectEffectByWDAD2Flags
3A:4001.note: reads the effect flags in wDAD2. First, when the low two bits of wBattleTarget are 3 and wBattleActionId is $85-$88, it returns unless wDAD2 bit 0 or bit 6 is set. Then it tests bits 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2 in that order and selects one of six tables (Data_03A_40CC, Data_03A_4294, Data_03A_445C, Data_03A_47EC, Data_03A_486C; bit 4 has its own branch) indexed by wBattleActionId. An entry of $FF returns; other entries go on to Jump_03A_48EC or the effect code, which is not read (E-0057)

3A:5762.name: SelectEffectByWDAD3Flags
3A:5762.note: reads the effect flags in wDAD3 and tests bits 7, 6, 5, 3, 2, 0 in that order. Bits 0 and 2 set wBattleActor to wBattleTarget and select a table (Data_03A_60B7 or Data_03A_6107) for the display; bits 7, 6, 5 and 3 go to routines not read (E-0057)

00:3E25.name: CheckSlotStatusBlock
00:3E25.note: A = slot: returns carry set when the slot is absent (CarryUnlessWDA63SlotEmpty) or when status +0 & $D0, +3 & $3F, +5 & $C0 or +8 bit 3 is set (wBattleStatus + 9 * slot); otherwise carry clear; A, BC, HL kept (E-0058)

32:57FD.name: ReadByteAtHLPlusA
32:57FD.note: HL += A, then A = the byte at HL

00:24F8.name: StepBGMapAddressBackOnScrollWrap
00:24F8.note: HL = BG map address. With col = (hScrollX / 8) & $1F: when col >= 12 and (L & $1F) < col - 12 (a column of the 20-column view that wrapped past entry 31), HL -= $20 and A = $FF; otherwise HL is unchanged and A = 0. BC and DE kept (E-0059)

00:18A5.name: CopyRectToBGMapWrapped
00:18A5.note: B = width, C = rows, DE = source, HL = BG map address: copies a B x C rectangle, wrapping columns inside each 32-entry row and rows inside $9800-$9BFF (H &= $9B). Each byte is written with interrupts off after rSTAT bit 1 clears. DE ends past the source, HL at the last row start, C = 0; B kept (E-0059)

00:2E81.name: CopyStringHLToDE
00:2E81.note: H = string category, L = string index, DE = destination: stores them in wStringDestLo/Hi, wStringCategory and wStringIndex and far-calls CopyStringToBuffer_Bank08, which copies the string with its $F0 terminator to DE (categories 9 and above go to Func_095_465F) (E-0059)

00:222B.name: LoadRecordListNameTiles
00:222B.note: fills wC8CF with five $90 glyphs and an $F0 terminator and draws it at vTiles1 + $500, $550 and $5A0 (three blank 5-tile slots); enables SRAM (rRAMG = $0A); then for each of the wC6FD record numbers listed at wC6FE copies that record's name (CopyRecordNameToWC8CF, C = 1) and draws it into the next slot ($50 bytes apart); disables SRAM after the loop. With wC6FD = 0 it returns with SRAM still enabled (E-0059)

00:3F32.name: BattlerRecordFieldAddress
00:3F32.note: A = battle slot, E = field offset: HL = wBattlerRecords + $4E * A' + E, where A' = A - 1 for A >= 3, so slots 0-2 and 4-6 map to records 0-5 (slots 3 and 7 have no record here; GetBaseHP handles them separately); clobbers A, BC (E-0059, E-0062)

39:71E5.name: GetBattleATK_Bank39
39:71E5.note: A = battle slot: HL = the word for that slot at wBattleATK; A = its low byte (the bank-$39 copy of GetBattleATK) (E-0060)

39:71EA.name: GetBattleDEF_Bank39
39:71EA.note: A = battle slot: HL = the word for that slot at wBattleDEF; A = its low byte (E-0060)

39:71EF.name: GetBattleMaxHP_Bank39
39:71EF.note: A = battle slot: HL = the word for that slot at wBattleMaxHP; A = its low byte (E-0060)

39:71F4.name: GetBattleMaxMP_Bank39
39:71F4.note: A = battle slot: HL = the word for that slot at wBattleMaxMP; A = its low byte (E-0060)

39:71F9.name: GetBattleHP_Bank39
39:71F9.note: A = battle slot: HL = the word for that slot at wBattleHP; A = its low byte (E-0060)

39:71FE.name: GetBattleMP_Bank39
39:71FE.note: A = battle slot: HL = the word for that slot at wBattleMP; A = its low byte (E-0060)

39:7203.name: GetBattleAGL_Bank39
39:7203.note: A = battle slot: HL = the word for that slot at wBattleAGL; A = its low byte (E-0060)

39:6FE2.name: SetActorTargetFromHRAMChoice
39:6FE2.note: HL = wBattleTargetChoice + 2 * wBattleActor; A = hFFC6, or hFFC9 when hFFC6 is $FF, or hFFC8 when both are $FF; stores A | hFFD0 at HL. What the bytes mean is not known (E-0060)

31:72CC.name: LayoutTileBlocksForWD890Count
31:72CC.note: wD890 = count 1-3: writes that many 6 x 6 blocks of consecutive tile numbers, starting at $14 ($24 per block), into the 32-byte-wide buffer at wC278 (row 0); left columns are 7 for one block, 4 and 10 for two, 1, 7 and 13 for three (centred in a 20-column view). Clobbers A, BC, D, HL (E-0060)

31:753F.name: CopyRect32StrideToVRAM
31:753F.note: B = width, C = rows, DE = source with 32-byte rows, HL = VRAM address with 32-byte rows: copies a B x C rectangle with WriteVRAMByteInc. DE ends 32 * C past its start and HL at the start of the row below; B kept, C = 0 (E-0060)

03:4425.name: UpdateMenuCursor
03:4425.note: HL = cursor byte (low nibble = row, bit 7 = page-changed flag). Up/Down (wJoypadPressedRepeat bits 6/7) move the row with wrap over wMenuRowCount, erase the old cursor (Func_003_44F0), play sound $69, store the row (clearing bit 7) and draw it (Func_003_4506). When wMenuPageCount >= 2, Left/Right (bits 5/4) step wMenuPage with wrap, clamp the row to wMenuLastPageRows - 1 on the last page, set bit 7 and play sound $69. With no input the cursor blinks every 16 frames. wFrameCounterLo is reset on each move (E-0060)

00:000B.name: JumpToWordAtHL
00:000B.note: HL = address of a word: HL = that word, then jumps to it (falls into JumpToHL); A = its low byte (E-0061)

39:4001.name: ChooseActionTarget
39:4001.note: wBattleActionId = wBattleActionChoice[2 * actor]; with mode = wDA53[actor], the entry at Data_039_41AC + 4 * mode holds two per-action routine tables, the second used for actors in slots 4-7 when wC58A is 0 or 2, the first otherwise; calls the routine for the action (JumpToWordAtHL), which writes a slot number to wBattleTargetChoice[2 * actor] (E-0061)

39:404B.name: TargetRandomFoe
39:404B.note: target = a present slot of the opposite three (slots 4-6 for actors 0-3, 0-2 for 4-7): the first present one, then each later present one replaces it when wC5E7 bit 7 is set after AdvanceRandom, so the last is favoured; $FF when none is present (E-0061)

39:4055.name: TargetSavedSlotOrRandomFoe
39:4055.note: target = the slot in wDA2D[2 * actor] when that slot is present, else TargetRandomFoe (E-0061)

39:4078.name: TargetFirstFoe
39:4078.note: target = the first present slot of the opposite three; base + 3 when none is present (E-0061)

39:40A2.name: TargetFirstAlly
39:40A2.note: target = the first present slot of the actor's own three (the actor included); base + 3 when none is present (E-0061)

39:40C2.name: TargetRandomAllySlot
39:40C2.note: target = one of the actor's own three slots by coin flips (wC5E7 bit 7), the later ones favoured; presence is not checked (E-0061)

39:412B.name: TargetSelf
39:412B.note: target = wBattleActor; the per-action entry used most often (334 table entries) (E-0061)

39:413C.name: TargetOwnSideFirstSlot
39:413C.note: target = wBattleActor & 4, slot 0 or 4 of the actor's side; presence is not checked (E-0061)

39:414F.name: TargetRandomOtherSlot
39:414F.note: target = a random slot (wC5E7 & 7 after AdvanceRandom) that is not the actor, is present and is not slot 3 or 7; retries until one is found (E-0061)

39:6691.name: TargetFoeWeightedBySlotOrder
39:6691.note: after AdvanceRandom, lists the present opposite slots in slot order (count in hFFC6, slots in hFFC7-hFFC9, unused entries $FF) and lets PickWeightedTargetCandidate choose (E-0061)

39:704E.name: PickWeightedTargetCandidate
39:704E.note: hFFC6 = candidate count, hFFC7-hFFC9 = candidates in priority order: target = the first for one; with two the first when wC5E7 < $AB (171/256), else the second; with three the first when wC5E7 < $80, the second when < $D5, else the third (128, 85 and 43 of 256). Writes wBattleTargetChoice[2 * actor]; with no candidates it stores hFFC7 ($FF) (E-0061)

5F:6B54.name: StepObjectTowardCoord
5F:6B54.note: wC929 = object number (16-byte entries): sets bit 2 of wCB8C + 16n, stores direction wC92A & 3 at wCB86 + 16n and moves the object one pixel, two when wC92A bit 7 is set: direction 0 adds the step to Y (wCB8B + 16n), 1 adds it to X (wCB8A + 16n), 2 subtracts it from Y, 3 from X. When the moved coordinate equals wC928 it clears bit 2 and sets wC92C = 1, else wC92C = 0 (E-0061)

5F:6C5A.name: ScriptStartFadeAndAdvanceStep
5F:6C5A.note: StartPaletteFade with A = $0F, wModeState = 4, wC8C5 = 0, wScriptParam0 = 0, then wScriptStep += 1 (E-0061)

F0:7C64.name: AddBToWordAtHLCapped
F0:7C64.note: HL = address of a word: word = min(word + B, DE) (CompareHLWithDE); DE kept; clobbers A, BC, HL (E-0061)

F0:7C81.name: CompareHLWithDE
F0:7C81.note: unsigned 16-bit compare: C = 0 when HL < DE, 1 when equal, $FF when HL > DE; clobbers A (E-0061)

0C:51F5.name: DrawScreenBufferRect_Bank0C
0C:51F5.note: DE = offset into wScreenTileBuffer, B = width, C = rows, HL = BG map address: CopyRectToBGMapWrapped from wScreenTileBuffer + DE; on CGB the same rectangle is then copied from wD000 + DE (rSVBK = 2) into VRAM bank 1, the attributes; on DMG BC, DE and HL are kept. wC554/wC555 = HL + $1C1 (row 14, column 1 of the drawn area) when wStringIndex is $18 or $12, otherwise $99C1 (E-0062)

0D:4E05.name: DrawScreenBufferRect_Bank0D
0D:4E05.note: DE = offset into wScreenTileBuffer, B = width, C = rows, HL = BG map address: CopyRectToBGMapWrapped from wScreenTileBuffer + DE; on CGB the same rectangle is then copied from wD000 + DE (rSVBK = 2) into VRAM bank 1, the attributes; on DMG BC, DE and HL are kept. wC554/wC555 = HL + $1C1, replaced by $99C1 when that is $9B61 (E-0062)

14:585B.name: DrawScreenBufferRect_Bank14
14:585B.note: DE = offset into wScreenTileBuffer, B = width, C = rows, HL = BG map address: CopyRectToBGMapWrapped from wScreenTileBuffer + DE; on CGB the same rectangle is then copied from wD000 + DE (rSVBK = 2) into VRAM bank 1, the attributes; on DMG BC, DE and HL are kept. wC554/wC555 = HL + $1C1 (E-0062)

F0:62F2.name: DrawScreenBufferRect_BankF0
F0:62F2.note: DE = offset into wScreenTileBuffer, B = width, C = rows, HL = BG map address: CopyRectToBGMapWrapped from wScreenTileBuffer + DE; on CGB the same rectangle is then copied from wD000 + DE (rSVBK = 2) into VRAM bank 1, the attributes; on DMG BC, DE and HL are kept. wC554/wC555 = HL + $1C1 (E-0062)

F1:59CA.name: DrawScreenBufferRect_BankF1
F1:59CA.note: DE = offset into wScreenTileBuffer, B = width, C = rows, HL = BG map address: CopyRectToBGMapWrapped from wScreenTileBuffer + DE; on CGB the same rectangle is then copied from wD000 + DE (rSVBK = 2) into VRAM bank 1, the attributes; on DMG BC, DE and HL are kept. wC554/wC555 = HL + $1C1 (E-0062)

15:65F1.name: DrawScreenBufferRect_Bank15
15:65F1.note: DE = offset into wScreenTileBuffer, B = width, C = rows, HL = BG map address: CopyRectToBGMapWrapped from wScreenTileBuffer + DE; on CGB the same rectangle is then copied from wD000 + DE (rSVBK = 2) into VRAM bank 1, the attributes; on DMG BC, DE and HL are kept. wC554/wC555 unchanged when wStringIndex is $10-$12; otherwise HL + $1C1, replaced by $99C1 when that is $9B61 (E-0062)

1E:74C8.name: DrawScreenBufferRect_Bank1E
1E:74C8.note: DE = offset into wScreenTileBuffer, B = width, C = rows, HL = BG map address: CopyRectToBGMapWrapped from wScreenTileBuffer + DE; on CGB the same rectangle is then copied from wD000 + DE (rSVBK = 2) into VRAM bank 1, the attributes; on DMG BC, DE and HL are kept. wC554/wC555 = HL + $1C1 only when HL = $9800 (E-0062)

24:6837.name: DrawScreenBufferRectNoOrigin_Bank24
24:6837.note: DE = offset into wScreenTileBuffer, B = width, C = rows, HL = BG map address: CopyRectToBGMapWrapped from wScreenTileBuffer + DE; on CGB the same rectangle is then copied from wD000 + DE (rSVBK = 2) into VRAM bank 1, the attributes; on DMG BC, DE and HL are kept. wC554/wC555 are not written (E-0062)

35:401C.name: CopySpeciesRecordPrefix
35:401C.note: B = byte count, DE = destination: copies the first B bytes of the species record for monster id wSpeciesIdLo/Hi (pointer table SpeciesRecordPointers, 384 entries, 47-byte records) to DE (E-0062, E-0069)

35:4001.name: LoadSpeciesRecord
35:4001.note: copies the whole 47-byte species record of monster id wSpeciesIdLo/Hi to wSpeciesRecord; byte 0 is the family (E-0069)

35:400A.name: LoadSpeciesFamily
35:400A.note: copies byte 0 of the species record of monster id wSpeciesIdLo/Hi, the family (0 Slime ... 9 Water, 10 Boss; $FF for an unused id), to wSpeciesRecord (E-0069)

35:4013.name: LoadSpeciesRecordWord0
35:4013.note: copies bytes 0-1 of the species record of monster id wSpeciesIdLo/Hi (the family and byte 1) to wSpeciesRecord (E-0069)

0F:7EE9.name: ScriptApplyStepDeltaAtDE
0F:7EE9.note: DE = address of a byte: adds the step delta for wScriptParam0 (AddStepDeltaToPointedByte), then wScriptParam0 += 2; when it reaches $20 it is reset to 0 and carry is set, otherwise A = 0 and carry is clear (16 calls per move) (E-0062)

16:4C1D.name: ConsumeSelectedItemByChance
16:4C1D.note: advances the random table (NextTableByte), takes A = (wC5E8:wC5E7) mod 100 and, when A < wD087, sets wItemId = $FF, clears wInventory[wD082] to $FF and runs CompactInventory; otherwise returns with carry clear and nothing changed (E-0063)

16:4C48.name: CompactInventory
16:4C48.note: copies the 24 wInventory bytes to wD09D, refills wInventory with $FF, then copies back every byte that is neither $FF nor $00, closing the gaps (E-0063)

05:413F.name: ActorCanPayMPCost_Bank05
05:413F.note: cost = wRecordBufferData (byte 0 of the skill record): C = $FF (can pay) when the cost is 0, when the cost is $FF and the actor's MP (wBattleMP word) is non-zero, or when MP >= cost; C = 0 otherwise. Agrees with CheckSkillMPCost that equal MP and cost is enough (E-0063)

1B:7439.name: ShowStringA10_Bank1B
1B:7439.note: wStringIndex = A + $10, wStringCategory = 0, then far-calls BeginStringDisplay_Bank1B_480C (E-0063)

1D:7B0F.name: SRAMRecordAddressOfWD7F1
1D:7B0F.note: HL = the word at wD7F3/wD7F4; DE = sA000 + $A5 * wD7F1, the start of SRAM record wD7F1 (records are $A5 bytes, as in SRAMRecordAddress); clobbers A, BC (E-0063)

12:6820.name: StartMessageA
12:6820.note: wMessageIndex = A, wMessageState = 0: the next RunMessageBox call opens the window and shows that string of the group already in wMessageGroup (E-0063, E-0079)

05:4001.name: GetBattleATK_Bank05
05:4001.note: A = battle slot: HL = the word for that slot at wBattleATK; A = its low byte (E-0064)

05:4006.name: GetBattleDEF_Bank05
05:4006.note: A = battle slot: HL = the word for that slot at wBattleDEF; A = its low byte (E-0064)

05:400B.name: GetBattleMaxHP_Bank05
05:400B.note: A = battle slot: HL = the word for that slot at wBattleMaxHP; A = its low byte (E-0064)

05:4010.name: GetBattleMaxMP_Bank05
05:4010.note: A = battle slot: HL = the word for that slot at wBattleMaxMP; A = its low byte (E-0064)

05:4015.name: GetBattleHP_Bank05
05:4015.note: A = battle slot: HL = the word for that slot at wBattleHP; A = its low byte (E-0064)

05:401A.name: GetBattleMP_Bank05
05:401A.note: A = battle slot: HL = the word for that slot at wBattleMP; A = its low byte (E-0064)

05:401F.name: GetBattleAGL_Bank05
05:401F.note: A = battle slot: HL = the word for that slot at wBattleAGL; A = its low byte (E-0064)

32:67FE.name: GetBattleMaxMP_Bank32
32:67FE.note: A = battle slot: HL = the word for that slot at wBattleMaxMP; A = its low byte (E-0064)

32:6803.name: GetBattleHP_Bank32
32:6803.note: A = battle slot: HL = the word for that slot at wBattleHP; A = its low byte (E-0064)

32:6808.name: GetBattleMP_Bank32
32:6808.note: A = battle slot: HL = the word for that slot at wBattleMP; A = its low byte (E-0064)

3A:7C66.name: GetBattleMaxHP_Bank3A
3A:7C66.note: A = battle slot: HL = the word for that slot at wBattleMaxHP; A = its low byte (E-0064)

3A:7C6B.name: GetBattleMaxMP_Bank3A
3A:7C6B.note: A = battle slot: HL = the word for that slot at wBattleMaxMP; A = its low byte (E-0064)

3A:7C75.name: GetBattleMP_Bank3A
3A:7C75.note: A = battle slot: HL = the word for that slot at wBattleMP; A = its low byte (E-0064)

3B:4F25.name: GetBattleMaxHP_Bank3B
3B:4F25.note: A = battle slot: HL = the word for that slot at wBattleMaxHP; A = its low byte (E-0064)

3B:4F2A.name: GetBattleMaxMP_Bank3B
3B:4F2A.note: A = battle slot: HL = the word for that slot at wBattleMaxMP; A = its low byte (E-0064)

A1:4001.name: GetBattleATK_BankA1
A1:4001.note: A = battle slot: HL = the word for that slot at wBattleATK; A = its low byte (E-0064)

A3:4001.name: GetBattleATK_BankA3
A3:4001.note: A = battle slot: HL = the word for that slot at wBattleATK; A = its low byte (E-0064)

E2:68A9.name: GetBattleATK_BankE2
E2:68A9.note: A = battle slot: HL = the word for that slot at wBattleATK; A = its low byte (E-0064)

36:5013.name: ComputeAttackDamage
36:5013.note: AdvanceRandom, then BC = the target's DEF (wBattleDEF) / 2 and falls into ComputeBasicDamage with HL = the actor's ATK (E-0064)

36:6510.name: ShiftHLRight4
36:6510.note: HL >>= 4 (unsigned): two shifts, then falls through ShiftHLRight2 (E-0064)

36:6518.name: ShiftHLRight2
36:6518.note: HL >>= 2 (unsigned): one shift, then falls through ShiftHLRight1 (E-0064)

37:5999.name: ShowStringIndexA_Bank37
37:5999.note: wStringIndex = A (wStringCategory unchanged), then far-calls BeginStringDisplay_Bank0E (E-0066)

05:4605.name: AnyFoeNotBlocked
05:4605.note: C = $FF when at least one of the actor's three opposite slots passes CheckSlotStatusBlock (present and none of its blocking status bits set); C = 0 when all three are absent or blocked (E-0066)

05:577F.name: FewerThanTwoFoesPresent
05:577F.note: counts the present slots among the actor's three opposite slots: C = $FF when fewer than two are present, C = 0 for two or three; E = the count (E-0066)

16:4636.name: CheckRecordFlag55Bit7
16:4636.note: A = record (SRAMRecordAddressMapped, offset $55; SRAM must be enabled): returns Z set when bit 7 of that byte is clear; when it is set, wItemId = $FF, A = $FF and Z is clear. What the bit means is not known (E-0066)

16:7321.name: CopyRect32StrideToVRAM_Bank16
16:7321.note: B = width, C = rows, DE = source with rows 32 bytes apart, HL = VRAM address with rows 32 bytes apart: copies a B x C rectangle with WriteVRAMByteInc; DE and HL end at the start of the row below; B kept, C = 0 (E-0066)

24:4E12.name: CopyRectTo20ByteRowsJp_Bank24
24:4E12.note: the same steps as CopyRectTo20ByteRows (copy a B x C rectangle from DE to HL with rows 20 bytes apart; on CGB zero-fill the same rectangle at HL + $0E68 with rSVBK = 2) but encoded with jp instead of jr, so its bytes differ (E-0066)

02:5EEE.name: SaveScreenBufferToBGMap1
02:5EEE.note: copies the first $168 bytes (20 x 18) of wScreenTileBuffer to vBGMap1 with WriteVRAMByteInc; on CGB also copies the $168 attribute bytes at wD000 to wD2D0 (rSVBK = 2); saves wSpriteSlotCount in wCB7E. RestoreScreenBufferFromBGMap1 undoes it (E-0066)

02:5F22.name: RestoreScreenBufferFromBGMap1
02:5F22.note: copies $168 bytes from vBGMap1 back to wScreenTileBuffer (WaitForVRAMAccess, interrupts off per byte); on CGB copies wD2D0 back to wD000 (rSVBK = 2); restores wSpriteSlotCount from wCB7E (E-0066)

1D:6540.name: UpdateTwoChoiceCursor_Bank1D
1D:6540.note: wTwoChoiceCursor (0 or 1): Up and Down each toggle it, erase the old cursor (tile $C3), draw the new one (tile $BB), play sound $69 and set wMenuInputResult = $FD; A draws the confirmed cursor (tile $BC), plays sound $69 and sets $FF; B sets $FE; with no input the cursor blinks (wD783 counts frames once wJoypadRepeatTimer reaches $14) and the result is 0. Cursor positions are BG map offsets $012F and $016F from the scroll origin (E-0068)

1B:63CB.name: UpdateTwoChoiceCursor_Bank1B
1B:63CB.note: the same instructions as UpdateTwoChoiceCursor_Bank1D, calling this bank's own helpers: wTwoChoiceCursor (0 or 1): Up and Down each toggle it, erase the old cursor (tile $C3), draw the new one (tile $BB), play sound $69 and set wMenuInputResult = $FD; A draws the confirmed cursor (tile $BC), plays sound $69 and sets $FF; B sets $FE; with no input the cursor blinks (wD783 counts frames once wJoypadRepeatTimer reaches $14) and the result is 0. Its cursor positions come from this bank's own table and were not compared (E-0068)

1D:65AE.name: BlinkTwoChoiceCursor
1D:65AE.note: once wJoypadRepeatTimer >= $14, counts wD783 up: frames 0-$0F draw the cursor, $10-$17 erase it, then the count restarts (E-0068)

1D:65C8.name: DrawTwoChoiceCursor
1D:65C8.note: writes tile $BB at the position of wTwoChoiceCursor (Data_01D_65F2 offset from BGMapAddressAtScroll, StepBGMapAddressBackOnScrollWrap) (E-0068)

1D:65CC.name: EraseTwoChoiceCursor
1D:65CC.note: writes tile $C3 at the position of wTwoChoiceCursor (E-0068)

1D:65D0.name: DrawTwoChoiceCursorConfirmed
1D:65D0.note: writes tile $BC at the position of wTwoChoiceCursor (E-0068)

1D:66B6.name: UpdatePagedListCursor
1D:66B6.note: row wD7AB runs 0..wD7B1 and page wD7AF runs 0..wD7B0 - 1, both wrapping; Up/Down move the row (wMenuInputResult = $FD), Left/Right move the page ($FB); a move erases the old cursor (tile $C3) and draws the new one (tile $BB) with sound $69; A draws tile $BC, plays sound $69 and sets $FF; B sets $FE. When the range is a single entry the press only blinks the cursor and the result is 0, as with no input (E-0068)

35:403B.name: SpeciesRecordPointers
35:403B.note: 384 pointers indexed by monster id (the numbering of StringTable_MonsterNames and StringTable_MonsterNames2) to 47-byte species records; byte 0 is the family index of StringTable_MonsterFamilies, $FF for an unused id (E-0069)

05:6CA5.name: GetSlotSpeciesFamily
05:6CA5.note: A = battle slot: A = the family (byte 0 of the species record) of the monster id in wBattleMonsterId[slot] (LoadSpeciesFamily); BC kept (E-0069)

05:5034.name: SlotFamilyBelowWater
05:5034.note: C = battle slot: loads the slot's species record (LoadSpeciesRecord); A = its family; carry set when the family is below 9 (Slime to Material), clear for Water (9) and Boss (10) (E-0069)

36:6594.name: GetTargetSpeciesFamily
36:6594.note: loads the species record of wBattleTarget's monster id (TargetMonsterIdAddress, LoadSpeciesRecord); A = its family (E-0069)

36:65A9.name: TargetMonsterIdAddress
36:65A9.note: HL = wBattleMonsterId + 2 * wBattleTarget, the target's monster id word (E-0069)

16:6A36.name: CopyMonsterNameOfWDAABSlotToDE
16:6A36.note: copies the name of the monster in slot wDAAB to DE: string category 2 + the id's high byte (StringTable_MonsterNames, then StringTable_MonsterNames2 from id 256), index = the low byte (CopyStringHLToDE) (E-0069)

16:5A7E.name: TestSpeciesFlag
16:5A7E.note: monster id = wSpeciesIdLo/Hi: HL = wSpeciesFlags + id / 8, B = the mask 1 << (id & 7) (Data_016_5AA7); C = A = [HL] & B, so Z is set when the species' bit is clear (E-0070)

16:5AAF.name: SetSpeciesFlag
16:5AAF.note: sets the bit of monster id wSpeciesIdLo/Hi in wSpeciesFlags (TestSpeciesFlag) and clears the high nibble of wC7FB (E-0070)

16:5AC0.name: CountSpeciesPerFamilyFlaggedOrListed
16:5AC0.note: zeroes the 11 per-family counters at wD09D, then for monster ids 0-372 ($175 is the end) skips unused ids (family $FF) and adds 1 to wD09D[family] when the species' flag is set (TestSpeciesFlag) or, when it is not, when Func_015_68FA finds the id in the list at wC7FC (wD7F5 not $FF). Leaves wSpeciesIdLo/Hi = 373 (E-0070)

00:1E29.name: DrawFullScreenBufferToBGMap
00:1E29.note: HL = BG map address: draws the 20 x 18 entries of wScreenTileBuffer, wrapping columns inside each 32-entry row and rows inside $9800-$9BFF; on CGB then draws the attribute bytes at wD000 (rSVBK = 2), masked to the palette bits (& $07), into VRAM bank 1; HL kept (E-0071)

00:15DE.name: CopyRectFromBankToVRAM
00:15DE.note: A = ROM bank, DE = source in that bank, B = width, C = rows, HL = VRAM with rows 32 bytes apart: switches to the bank, copies the rectangle with WriteVRAMByteInc (interrupts off per byte; source rows packed), then restores the bank; B kept (E-0071)

00:2431.name: CopyItemNameToDE
00:2431.note: A = item number: with ROM bank $08 mapped, copies that string of StringTable_ItemNames, including its $F0 terminator, to DE; restores the bank (E-0071)

01:6A7E.name: WriteHexByteTilesAtDE
01:6A7E.note: DE = VRAM address: writes A as two hex-digit tiles ($10 + high nibble, then $10 + low nibble), each after WaitForVRAMAccess; DE ends on the second tile (E-0071)

07:4AFE.name: CopyRecordRectToScreenBuffer_Bank07
07:4AFE.note: the same effect as CopyRecordRectToScreenBuffer with the copy loop's instructions in a different order: HL = header (word offset, width, rows) followed by tile bytes, copied into wScreenTileBuffer + offset with rows 32 bytes apart (E-0071)

05:6FA1.name: AnySlotLacksStatusMask
05:6FA1.note: A = first slot, B = slot count, HL = a status field (wBattleStatus + n), E = mask: C = $FF when some present slot in the range has (HL + 9 * slot) & E clear; C = 0 when every slot is absent or has a masked bit set (E-0071)

05:41D6.name: SkillPassesRepeatCheck
05:41D6.note: when bit 7 of wCFF6 (in the skill record buffer) is set and the skill wRecordBuffer is the queued action (QueuedActionMatches), C = 0; otherwise C = $FF (E-0071)

05:41FD.name: AnyFoeLacksStatus5Bits67
05:41FD.note: C = $FF when one of the actor's three opposite slots is present with status byte 5 (wD811) & $C0 clear (AnySlotLacksStatusMask), else 0 (E-0071)

05:420F.name: AnyFoeLacksStatus2Bit3
05:420F.note: C = $FF when one of the actor's three opposite slots is present with status byte 2 (wD80E) bit 3 clear (AnySlotLacksStatusMask), else 0 (E-0071)

05:4221.name: AnyFoeLacksStatus3And4Bits
05:4221.note: C = $FF when one of the actor's three opposite slots is present with status byte 3 (wD80F) & $C0 and byte 4 (wD810) & $0C both clear, else 0 (E-0071)

05:7616.name: CheckSkillUsableElseResetWDA6E
05:7616.note: runs ActorCanPayMPCost_Bank05, SkillPassesRepeatCheck, AnyFoeLacksStatus5Bits67, AnyFoeLacksStatus2Bit3 and AnyFoeLacksStatus3And4Bits in turn; at the first that returns C = 0 it calls ResetWDA6E; returns with nothing changed when all pass (E-0071)

5F:6A94.name: StepPlayerDownTowardWC928
5F:6A94.note: sets bit 2 of hFF8C (moving) and hPlayerFacing = 0; calls Func_05F_6B43 with the coordinate; then hPlayerY += 1; when it equals wC928 bit 2 is cleared and wC92C = 1, else wC92C = 0 (E-0071)

5F:6ABF.name: StepPlayerRightTowardWC928
5F:6ABF.note: sets bit 2 of hFF8C (moving) and hPlayerFacing = 1; calls Func_05F_6B43 with the coordinate; then hPlayerX += 1; when it equals wC928 bit 2 is cleared and wC92C = 1, else wC92C = 0 (E-0071)

5F:6AEB.name: StepPlayerUpTowardWC928
5F:6AEB.note: sets bit 2 of hFF8C (moving) and hPlayerFacing = 2; calls Func_05F_6B43 with the coordinate; then hPlayerY -= 1; when it equals wC928 bit 2 is cleared and wC92C = 1, else wC92C = 0 (E-0071)

5F:6B17.name: StepPlayerLeftTowardWC928
5F:6B17.note: sets bit 2 of hFF8C (moving) and hPlayerFacing = 3; calls Func_05F_6B43 with the coordinate; then hPlayerX -= 1; when it equals wC928 bit 2 is cleared and wC92C = 1, else wC92C = 0 (E-0071)

5F:6C8C.name: AppendItemWC928ToInventory
5F:6C8C.note: stores wC928 in the first wInventory slot that is $00 or $FF (no bound check), then sets bit 6 of wC836; HL kept (E-0071)

05:4707.name: ActorLacksStatus4Bits67
05:4707.note: C = 0 when the actor's status byte 4 (wD810 + 9 * actor) & $C0 is set, else C = $FF (E-0071)

05:4169.name: SkillPassesStatus1Bit0Check
05:4169.note: C = 0 when bit 6 of wCFF3 (skill record buffer) is set and the actor's status byte 1 (wD80D) bit 0 is set, else $FF (compare refusal code 3 of CheckSkillMPCost) (E-0071)

05:41B9.name: SkillPassesSideFlagBit3Check
05:41B9.note: when bit 3 is set in wD80A or wD80B (either side), C = 0 if the skill wRecordBuffer is $84 or wCFF3 bit 6 is set; otherwise C = $FF (compare refusal code 4 of CheckSkillMPCost, which tests only the actor's side) (E-0071)

05:7494.name: CheckSkillUsableStatusElseResetWDA6E
05:7494.note: runs ActorCanPayMPCost_Bank05, SkillPassesStatus1Bit0Check, SkillPassesSideFlagBit3Check and SkillPassesRepeatCheck in turn; at the first that returns C = 0 it calls ResetWDA6E (E-0071)

05:431C.name: AnyFoeLacksStatus0Bit6
05:431C.note: C = $FF when one of the actor's three opposite slots is present with status byte 0 (wBattleStatus) bit 6 clear (AnySlotLacksStatusMask), else 0 (E-0071)

16:6955.name: ShowStringCategory5_Bank16
16:6955.note: wStringCategory = 5 (wStringIndex set by the caller), then far-calls BeginStringDisplay_Bank2F (E-0072)

24:4EE8.name: ShowStringAInDefaultWindow_Bank24
24:4EE8.note: wStringIndex = A, wStringCategory = 0, string window = vTiles1 with size word $1202 (as SetDefaultStringWindow), then far-calls BeginStringDisplay_Bank33_7037 (E-0072)

0C:52EC.name: GridIndexFromWD786WD787
0C:52EC.note: A = 6 * wD787 + wD786 (row-major index in a 6-column grid: wD786 column, wD787 row); BC kept (E-0072)

04:449F.name: ClearBit1OfPlayerAndObjectFlags
04:449F.note: clears bit 1 of hFF8C and of the flag byte (wCB8C + 16 * n) of object entries 0-4 (E-0072)

00:2FE1.name: CopyFiveGlyphsPlusMarks
00:2FE1.note: copies from DE to HL until 5 glyphs other than $8D and $8E have been copied ($8D/$8E, which have no charmap entry, are copied without counting); a $8D or $8E right after the fifth glyph is copied too; then writes $F0. Clobbers A, B; DE and HL advance (E-0072)

1C:6ADB.name: ResetWD7C2Counters
1C:6ADB.note: clears wD7C2-wD7C6, wD7C8 and wD7C9, and sets wD7C7 = $3C (60) (E-0072)

05:69DA.name: ActorLacksStatus2Bit1And4Bits01
05:69DA.note: C = 0 when the actor's status byte 2 (wD80E) bit 1 or byte 4 & $03 is set, else C = $FF (E-0072)

05:53CA.name: ActorLacksStatus1Bits23And4Bits01
05:53CA.note: C = 0 when the actor's status byte 1 (wD80D) & $0C or byte 4 & $03 is set, else C = $FF (E-0072)

33:6152.name: CopyRectTo20ByteRowsJp_Bank33
33:6152.note: the same instructions as CopyRectTo20ByteRowsJp_Bank24: copies a B x C rectangle from DE to HL with rows 20 bytes apart; on CGB zero-fills the same rectangle at HL + $0E68 with rSVBK = 2 (E-0072)

30:541B.name: ActorActionChoiceAddress
30:541B.note: HL = wBattleActionChoice + 2 * wBattleActor (the actor's action byte; the target follows) (E-0072)

31:7479.name: DrawWC338RowsToBGMapRow13
31:7479.note: copies a 20 x 5 rectangle from wC338 (rows 32 bytes apart) to vBGMap0 + $1A0 (row 13) with CopyRect32StrideToVRAM (E-0073)

07:4B1E.name: DrawScreenBufferToBGMap0_Bank07
07:4B1E.note: copies the 20 x 18 entries of wScreenTileBuffer to vBGMap0 (rows 32 apart) with CopyRect32StrideToVRAM_Bank07 (E-0073)

07:4B27.name: CopyRect32StrideToVRAM_Bank07
07:4B27.note: the same instructions as CopyRect32StrideToVRAM_Bank16: B = width, C = rows, DE = source and HL = VRAM, both with rows 32 bytes apart; copies with WriteVRAMByteInc; B kept, C = 0 (E-0073)

36:7C9C.name: ClearDamageAndStoreWDAC0_Bank36
36:7C9C.note: clears wBattleDamageLo/wD873 (the damage word), then wDAC2 = L, wDAC0 = C, wDAC1 = B (E-0073)

3B:4ECF.name: ClearDamageAndStoreWDAC0_Bank3B
3B:4ECF.note: clears wBattleDamageLo/wD873 (the damage word), then wDAC2 = L, wDAC0 = C, wDAC1 = B (the same instructions as the bank-$36 copy) (E-0073)

1C:431F.name: CopyRectTo20ByteRowsJp_Bank1C
1C:431F.note: the same instructions as CopyRectTo20ByteRowsJp_Bank24: copies a B x C rectangle from DE to HL with rows 20 bytes apart; on CGB zero-fills the same rectangle at HL + $0E68 with rSVBK = 2 (E-0073)

01:4A75.name: FillRectWithTileSequence
01:4A75.note: A = first tile, B = width, C = rows, HL = BG map address (rows 32 apart): writes consecutive tile numbers A, A + 1, ... row by row; on CGB then zero-fills the $240 bytes at vBGMap0 in VRAM bank 1 (all attributes 0, regardless of the rectangle) (E-0073)

00:08AD.name: StartSerialTransferInternalClock
00:08AD.note: with interrupts off, LoadSerialByte, then sets rSC bits 0 (internal clock) and 7 (start transfer) (E-0073)

36:5D84.name: StoreBCAtWordEntryWD871
36:5D84.note: HL = table: stores BC (low byte first) at HL + 2 * wD871 (E-0073)

1B:47CA.name: RunFrameTickFadeAndCounter_Bank1B
1B:47CA.note: calls Func_000_2620 when wC52B is non-zero, then StepFade; adds 1 to the 16-bit wFrameCounterLo/Hi and clears wC58D and wC58E (E-0073)

1C:440F.name: IsAmountInWD7F1AboveGold
1C:440F.note: compares the 24-bit value wD7F3:wD7F2:wD7F1 (wD7F3 most significant) with wGoldHi:wGoldMid:wGoldLo: wD7F1 = $FF when it is greater, 0 when it is less or equal (the low byte is overwritten with the result) (E-0073)

00:2EAC.name: WriteDecimalByteString
00:2EAC.note: HL = destination: writes A (0-255) as 1-3 decimal digit glyphs (charmap '0' = $00) without leading zeros, then $F0; HL ends on the terminator; clobbers A, D, E (E-0074)

00:2EC5.name: WriteDecimalDigitForE
00:2EC5.note: D = A / E by repeated subtraction, stored at HL; HL += 1; A = the remainder (E-0074)

1E:76DA.name: StoreHFFC6BytesToSRAMRecord
1E:76DA.note: A = record, C = field offset (SRAMRecordAddress), B = count: copies B bytes from hFFC6 onward into the SRAM record (SRAM must be enabled); DE and HL kept (E-0074)

16:6961.name: ShowStringCategory5Immediate_Bank16
16:6961.note: wStringCategory = 5 (wStringIndex set by the caller), then far-calls ShowString_Bank2F (E-0074)

15:67E5.name: BlankWordTableTargets
15:67E5.note: HL = table of addresses, C = count: stores tile $C3 at the address in each of the first C entries (StoreBAtWordTableEntry_Bank15) (E-0074)

12:6990.name: CountKeysOrFull
12:6990.note: counts the 4-byte wKeyList entries before the first $FF: hFFC6 = the count, or $80 when all 32 are in use (E-0074)

1C:4C9A.name: DrawWD7B5Cursor
1C:4C9A.note: writes the cursor tile $BB at the position for wD7B5 (0-3; BG map offsets $00A2, $00E2, $0122, $0162 from the scroll origin, Data_01C_4CC4), via StepBGMapAddressBackOnScrollWrap and WaitForVRAMAccess (E-0074)

1C:4C9E.name: EraseWD7B5Cursor
1C:4C9E.note: writes the blank tile $C3 at the position for wD7B5 (0-3; BG map offsets $00A2, $00E2, $0122, $0162 from the scroll origin, Data_01C_4CC4), via StepBGMapAddressBackOnScrollWrap and WaitForVRAMAccess (E-0074)

1C:4CA2.name: DrawWD7B5CursorConfirmed
1C:4CA2.note: writes the confirmed-cursor tile $BC at the position for wD7B5 (0-3; BG map offsets $00A2, $00E2, $0122, $0162 from the scroll origin, Data_01C_4CC4), via StepBGMapAddressBackOnScrollWrap and WaitForVRAMAccess (E-0074)

12:7EC2.name: AddGoldCapped
12:7EC2.note: adds the word hFFC6/hFFC7 to the 24-bit wGoldLo/Mid/Hi and caps the result at $01869F (99,999) (E-0074)

07:695A.name: InitGoldAndClearInventory
07:695A.note: wGold = 100 and the 24 wInventory slots = 0 (the new-game setup path, Func_007_65F1) (E-0074)

24:68B0.name: DrawGoldPanel_Bank24
24:68B0.note: copies an 8 x 3 frame (Data_024_68EB) into the screen buffer at wC370, converts wGold to packed BCD (Number24ToPackedBCD) and Func_015_6676, then writes the digits as tiles $E0 + d at wC386 (E-0074)

15:68FA.name: TestBitInFieldAtWD7F3
15:68FA.note: index = the word wD7F1/wD7F2, field = the address in wD7F3/wD7F4: wD7F5 = $FF when bit index of the field is set (bit order $80 first within each byte), else 0 (E-0074)

12:7E84.name: SubtractGoldFloorZero
12:7E84.note: wGold -= the word hFFC6/hFFC7; when gold is smaller than the amount it becomes 0 instead (E-0075)

12:7F1C.name: DeductGoldPenalty
12:7F1C.note: takes gold: all of it when below 150, 150 when below 1,500 ($05DC), otherwise one tenth (Divide24ByA, rounded down) (E-0075)

05:6972.name: ActorStatus4CheckReadsAddress
05:6972.note: apparently meant to test the actor's status byte 4 (wD810 + 9 * actor) & $03 like the neighbouring checks, but it never loads the byte: it tests A & 3 where A is the low byte of that address left by AddAx9ToHL. So C = $FF for slots 0 and 4 and C = 0 for slots 1, 2, 5 and 6 whatever the status (a likely bug; executed, test Status4CheckReadsAddress) (E-0075)

12:7662.name: EventCheckGoldAtLeast10000
12:7662.note: when story flag $192 is set, flag $193 is clear and gold >= 10,000 ($2710): wC935 = $CC and carry set; otherwise A = 0 and carry clear (E-0075)

31:7536.name: DrawWC278RowsToBGMapRow7
31:7536.note: copies a 20 x 11 rectangle from wC278 (rows 32 bytes apart) to vBGMap0 + $E0 (row 7), falling into CopyRect32StrideToVRAM (E-0075)

1E:76F3.name: GetWD789Cell4Address
1E:76F3.note: far-calls SetWD7F5ToWD789Cell4, then HL = wD7F5 (high) / wD7F6 (low) (E-0075)

1E:76EB.name: GetWD789Cell5Address
1E:76EB.note: far-calls SetWD7F5ToWD789Cell5, then HL = wD7F5 (high) / wD7F6 (low) (E-0075)

02:4176.name: FadeColorComponentFloor
02:4176.note: the 5-bit component in C's low bits becomes max(component, wC572) when wC56D bit 7 is clear (lighten toward the level) or max(component - wC572, 0) when it is set (darken); then B:C:D:E is rotated right 5 bits so the next component comes down and the result collects in D:E (E-0076)

02:426D.name: FadeColorComponentAdd
02:426D.note: the 5-bit component in C's low bits becomes min(component + wC572, $1F) when wC56D bit 7 is clear (lighten) or max(component - wC572, 0) when it is set (darken); then B:C:D:E is rotated right 5 bits so the next component comes down and the result collects in D:E (E-0076)

02:4152.name: WriteFadedColorFloorToBGPD
02:4152.note: reads one RGB555 colour word at HL (HL += 2), passes its three components through FadeColorComponentFloor and writes the result to rBGPD (low byte first, after WaitForVRAMAccess) (E-0076)

02:4121.name: WriteFadedColorFloorToOBPD
02:4121.note: reads one RGB555 colour word at HL (HL += 2), passes its three components through FadeColorComponentFloor and writes the result to rOBPD (low byte first, after WaitForVRAMAccess); its load of wC572 into D is overwritten at once (E-0076)

02:4249.name: WriteFadedColorAddToBGPD
02:4249.note: reads one RGB555 colour word at HL (HL += 2), passes its three components through FadeColorComponentAdd and writes the result to rBGPD (low byte first, after WaitForVRAMAccess) (E-0076)

02:4218.name: WriteFadedColorAddToOBPD
02:4218.note: reads one RGB555 colour word at HL (HL += 2), passes its three components through FadeColorComponentAdd and writes the result to rOBPD (low byte first, after WaitForVRAMAccess); its load of wC572 into D is overwritten at once (E-0076)

02:4149.name: WriteFadedPaletteFloorToBGPD
02:4149.note: four colours (one palette) from HL through WriteFadedColorFloorToBGPD (E-0076)

02:4118.name: WriteFadedPaletteFloorToOBPD
02:4118.note: four colours (one palette) from HL through WriteFadedColorFloorToOBPD (E-0076)

02:4240.name: WriteFadedPaletteAddToBGPD
02:4240.note: four colours (one palette) from HL through WriteFadedColorAddToBGPD (E-0076)

02:420F.name: WriteFadedPaletteAddToOBPD
02:420F.note: four colours (one palette) from HL through WriteFadedColorAddToOBPD (E-0076)

02:40CF.name: WriteAllFadedPalettesFloor
02:40CF.note: rBGPI = $80 (palette 0, auto-increment), the 8 BG palettes from wC49F through WriteFadedPaletteFloorToBGPD; then rOBPI = $80 and the 8 OBJ palettes from wC4DF through WriteFadedPaletteFloorToOBPD (E-0076)

02:41C6.name: WriteAllFadedPalettesAdd
02:41C6.note: rBGPI = $80, the 8 BG palettes from wC49F through WriteFadedPaletteAddToBGPD; then rOBPI = $80 and the 8 OBJ palettes from wC4DF through WriteFadedPaletteAddToOBPD (E-0076)

03:4DCF.name: ShowSkillNameAtSlotB
03:4DCF.note: A = skill number ($FF shows entry 0), B = slot: wStringIndex = A, wStringCategory = 4 (StringTable_SkillNames in the bank-$08 database), then ShowStringBank08AtTilesHL with the tile address from Data_003_4DF2[B] and size $0901; HL kept (E-0076)

F2:516E.name: CopyTileBytesToVRAMCounted_BankF2
F2:516E.note: copies 16 bytes from HL to DE, each written with interrupts off after rSTAT bit 1 clears (the same effect as CopyTileBytesToVRAM, with a counter kept on the stack); HL and DE advance (E-0076)

A0:4C74.name: DrawWC338RowsToBGMapRow13_BankA0
A0:4C74.note: copies a 20 x 5 rectangle from wC338 (rows 32 bytes apart) to vBGMap0 + $1A0 (row 13) with CopyRect32StrideToVRAM_BankA0, as DrawWC338RowsToBGMapRow13 does in bank $31 (E-0076)

02:4071.name: StepCGBFade
02:4071.note: one CGB fade step: counts wFadeDelayCounter down and, when it reaches 0, reloads it from wFadeDelay and moves wFadeLevel by 5. With wFadeState bit 7 clear (fading out) the level rises to at most $1F and WriteAllFadedPalettesFloor writes the palettes; with bit 7 set (fading in) it falls to at least 0 and WriteAllFadedPalettesAdd writes them. wFadeState = 0 when the level reaches $1F or 0 (E-0077)

00:3A4E.name: WriteChannelRegisterC
00:3A4E.note: A = value, C = register offset: writes A to $FF00 + wDD0D + C (wDD0D holds the current sound channel's register base); B = A (E-0077)

00:210D.name: WriteTwoDigitTilesFromWC8C1
00:210D.note: DE = destination: writes wC8C1 as tile $E0 + digit, or blank tile $C3 when it is 0, then wC8C2 as $E0 + digit; DE ends past the second tile; HL kept (E-0077)

05:44CF.name: AnyFoeLacksStatus0MaskCC
05:44CF.note: C = $FF when one of the actor's three opposite slots is present with status byte 0 (wBattleStatus) & $CC clear (AnySlotLacksStatusMask), else 0 (E-0077)

E0:740E.name: FillVRAMRectWithTileSequence
E0:740E.note: A = first tile, B = width, C = rows, HL = VRAM address, DE = row stride: writes consecutive tile numbers with WriteVRAMByteInc (interrupts off per byte), adding DE to the row start after each row; A ends past the last tile (E-0077)

84:43AC.name: RandomBelowC
84:43AC.note: repeats NextRandomSeed until wCD04 & $0F is below C (C must be 1-16); returns A = that value (E-0077)

3B:42F0.name: LoadBCFromHL
3B:42F0.note: C = [HL], B = [HL + 1]; HL ends on the high byte (E-0077)

36:608B.name: StoreBCAtActorWordEntry
36:608B.note: HL = table: stores BC (low byte first) at HL + 2 * wBattleActor; HL ends on the high byte (E-0077)

31:74C8.name: DrawWC2B8RowsToBGMapRow9
31:74C8.note: copies a 20 x 9 rectangle from wC2B8 (rows 32 bytes apart) to vBGMap0 + $120 (row 9) with CopyRect32StrideToVRAM, then wD868 = 1 (E-0077)

3A:79A0.name: CopyBattlerNameToHL
3A:79A0.note: A = battle slot (0-2 or 4-6): copies the name at offset 0 of the slot's battler record (5 glyphs, CopyFiveGlyphsPlusMarks) to HL and leaves HL on the $F0 terminator; BC kept (E-0077)

3A:799C.name: CopySlotNameToHL
3A:799C.note: A = battle slot: slots 0-2 go to CopyBattlerNameToHL; other slots take paths that check slot 3/7, wC58A and wDAD4 (not fully read) (E-0077)

3A:7927.name: CopyTargetNameToWC130
3A:7927.note: wD86C = wBattleTarget, then CopySlotNameToHL with HL = wC130 (E-0077)

F1:4AA8.name: ClearScreenBufferAndAttributes_BankF1
F1:4AA8.note: fills the $2D0 bytes $C198-$C467 (wScreenTileBuffer, $240 bytes, and the $90 bytes after it) with $C3; on CGB continues with the attribute buffer (not fully read) (E-0077)

00:3048.name: AdvanceBGMapColumnsByB
00:3048.note: moves HL B entries to the right inside its 32-entry BG map row, wrapping at the row end (NextBGMapColumn B times); B = 0 (E-0078)

00:2FC7.name: DivideBCByDE
00:2FC7.note: A = BC / DE by repeated subtraction (the quotient must fit in 8 bits), BC = the remainder; HL kept (E-0078)

05:4664.name: AnyFoeHasClearStatus3
05:4664.note: C = $FF when one of the actor's three opposite slots is present with status byte 3 (wD80F) entirely clear (AnySlotLacksStatusMask with mask $FF), else 0 (E-0078)

39:6FC8.name: SetActorTargetFromHFFC6OrHFFC9
39:6FC8.note: wBattleTargetChoice[2 * actor] = (hFFC6, or hFFC9 when hFFC6 is $FF) | hFFD0 (the two-choice form of SetActorTargetFromHRAMChoice) (E-0078)

1A:6579.name: AddWD09CIfWD09BMatchesB
1A:6579.note: A = C + (wD09C when wD09B = B, else 0) (E-0078)

31:7529.name: DrawWC2F8RectToBGMapRow11
31:7529.note: copies a 14 x 7 rectangle from wC2F8 (rows 32 bytes apart) to vBGMap0 + $160 (row 11) with CopyRect32StrideToVRAM (E-0078)

31:74E1.name: DrawWC2B8LeftToBGMapRow9
31:74E1.note: copies an 8 x 9 rectangle from wC2B8 (rows 32 bytes apart) to vBGMap0 + $120 (row 9, column 0) with CopyRect32StrideToVRAM (E-0078)

31:74B4.name: DrawWC2B8LeftToBGMapRow9_74B4

16:468E.name: ApplyItemEffect
16:468E.note: returns when wItemId is $FF; otherwise jumps through a 95-entry table with one effect per item id. The Herb entry adds (wC5E7 after NextTableByte) / 11 + wD08F to record wD083 (Func_016_57D1) and then runs ConsumeSelectedItemByChance; CheckItemUsable is the matching usability check (E-0089)

00:2E5D.name: IncrementWC533Word
00:2E5D.note: HL = the word at wC533/wC534, then that word += 1 (E-0090)

00:18D6.name: ReadFarPointerAtDEInBankB
00:18D6.note: with ROM bank B mapped, reads three bytes at DE: HL = the word, B = the third byte (a far pointer: address then bank); DE += 3; restores the bank (E-0090)

00:305E.name: AddHLToTextCursorWC554
00:305E.note: HL = wC554/wC555 + HL, with the high byte's low 2 bits wrapped and its upper 6 bits kept from wC555 (stays inside one 1 KB BG map) (E-0090)

00:3EDE.name: NextTableByteSecondStream
00:3EDE.note: advances a second random stream: loads the state in wC5BA/wC5BB into wC5E7/wC5E8, runs NextTableByte and stores the result back in wC5BA/wC5BB (wC5E7/wC5E8 keep the new value); HL kept (E-0090)

00:2458.name: WriteKeyNameToDE
00:2458.note: A = key slot, or $FE: writes 'Magic Key' to DE; otherwise writes the name of key A in wKeyList (4-byte entries from $C708): the word numbered byte 0 + 1, then the word numbered byte 1 + $11 (CopyKeyNameWordToDE), then $F0 (E-0090)

00:24A2.name: CopyKeyNameWordToDE
00:24A2.note: A = word number: with ROM bank $09 mapped, copies that string of the bank-$09 database's category 3 (Data_009_4078: Ylw, Plain, Green, ... then Slime, Draco, Beast, ... Cave, Isle) with its $F0 to DE; restores the bank (E-0090)

00:160B.name: CopyRectFromBankToBGMapWrapped
00:160B.note: A = ROM bank, DE = source in that bank, B = width, C = rows, HL = BG map address: switches to the bank and copies the rectangle with WriteVRAMByteInc (interrupts off per byte), wrapping columns inside each 32-entry row and rows inside $9800-$9BFF (H &= $9B); restores the bank (E-0090)

00:3095.name: BlankBGMapEntriesRight
00:3095.note: writes tile $C3 (WriteVRAMByte) to B BG map entries from HL rightward, wrapping inside the 32-entry row (NextBGMapColumn); B = 0 (E-0090)

00:2DED.name: CopyCBytesToVRAMWaitSTAT
00:2DED.note: copies C bytes from HL to DE, waiting for rSTAT bit 1 to clear before each (interrupts stay on); HL and DE advance, C = 0 (E-0090)

00:0DCA.name: ResetFadeFromWC5E9
00:0DCA.note: wC56F-wC571 = wC5E9-wC5EB; then clears wFadeLevel and the four bytes after it and wFadeState, and sets wC56D = 7 and wC56E = $1F (E-0090)

00:3072.name: BGMapAddressAtScrollPlusHL
00:3072.note: HL = offset in a 32 x 32 BG map: returns HL = $9800 + ((HL + (hScrollY & $F8) * 4 + hScrollX / 8) & $3FF), the entry that offset points at from the scroll origin, wrapping inside the map (E-0090)

00:2F5A.name: Divide24ByHFFCCDE
00:2F5A.note: A = the 24-bit hFFC8:hFFC7:hFFC6 divided by the 24-bit hFFCC:D:E (repeated subtraction; the quotient must fit in 8 bits); the remainder is left in hFFC6-hFFC8; HL kept (E-0090)

00:2F36.name: Quotient24ByHFFCCDE
00:2F36.note: Divide24ByHFFCCDE with hFFC6-hFFC8 restored afterwards (A = the quotient); uses wC0A0, wC0A1 and wMenuRowCount as scratch, so wMenuRowCount is overwritten (E-0090)

05:55F3.name: CheckWD044RuleBit5
05:55F3.note: C = 0 (fail) when wC58A is neither 0 nor 2, wD044 bits 7 and 5 are set, and either wD045 bit 5 is clear or bit 5 is set in the actor side's byte wD057[actor / 4]; otherwise C = $FF (E-0091)

E2:6854.name: WeighWD044RuleBit5
E2:6854.note: far-calls CheckWD044RuleBit5; when it fails (C = 0) adds weight-table entry $0E to wDA70 (AccumulateBank6WordToDA70); used by the AI scoring routines (E-0091)

05:5628.name: CheckWD044RuleBit4
05:5628.note: C = 0 (fail) when wC58A is neither 0 nor 2, wD044 bits 7 and 4 are set, and either wD045 bit 4 is clear or bit 4 is set in the actor side's byte wD057[actor / 4]; otherwise C = $FF (E-0091)

E2:6865.name: WeighWD044RuleBit4
E2:6865.note: far-calls CheckWD044RuleBit4; when it fails (C = 0) adds weight-table entry $0E to wDA70 (AccumulateBank6WordToDA70); used by the AI scoring routines (E-0091)

05:565D.name: CheckWD044RuleBit3
05:565D.note: C = 0 (fail) when wC58A is neither 0 nor 2, wD044 bits 7 and 3 are set, and either wD045 bit 3 is clear or bit 3 is set in the actor side's byte wD057[actor / 4]; otherwise C = $FF (E-0091)

E2:6876.name: WeighWD044RuleBit3
E2:6876.note: far-calls CheckWD044RuleBit3; when it fails (C = 0) adds weight-table entry $0E to wDA70 (AccumulateBank6WordToDA70); used by the AI scoring routines (E-0091)

05:5692.name: CheckWD044RuleBit2
05:5692.note: C = 0 (fail) when wC58A is neither 0 nor 2, wD044 bits 7 and 2 are set, and either wD045 bit 2 is clear or bit 2 is set in the actor side's byte wD057[actor / 4]; otherwise C = $FF (E-0091)

E2:6887.name: WeighWD044RuleBit2
E2:6887.note: far-calls CheckWD044RuleBit2; when it fails (C = 0) adds weight-table entry $0E to wDA70 (AccumulateBank6WordToDA70); used by the AI scoring routines (E-0091)

05:56C7.name: CheckWD044RuleBit1
05:56C7.note: C = 0 (fail) when wC58A is neither 0 nor 2, wD044 bits 7 and 1 are set, and either wD045 bit 1 is clear or bit 1 is set in the actor side's byte wD057[actor / 4]; otherwise C = $FF (E-0091)

E2:6898.name: WeighWD044RuleBit1
E2:6898.note: far-calls CheckWD044RuleBit1; when it fails (C = 0) adds weight-table entry $0E to wDA70 (AccumulateBank6WordToDA70); used by the AI scoring routines (E-0091)

05:4C5D.name: CheckLoneFoeHPNotBelowWD2C1
05:4C5D.note: counts the present slots among the actor's three opposite slots (D = the last one found); when fewer than two are present and that foe's HP (GetBattleHP_Bank05) is below the word wD2C1[2 * (slot & 3)], C = 0; otherwise C = $FF. With no foe present D is not set by this routine (E-0091)

05:57CF.name: CheckFoeStatus6Bit3
05:57CF.note: C = 1 when wDA53[actor] (the AI mode) is below 3; otherwise C = 0 when one of the actor's three opposite slots is present with status byte 6 (wD812) bit 3 set, else C = $FF (E-0092)

05:4777.name: AllOtherAlliesHaveStatus0Bit6
05:4777.note: looks at the actor's own three slots other than the actor: C = $FF when one of them is present with status byte 0 (wBattleStatus) bit 6 clear, or when none of them is present; otherwise (every present ally has bit 6) C = 0 (E-0092)

05:6FD9.name: FoeOfFamilyEPresent
05:6FD9.note: E = family: C = 0 when one of the actor's three opposite slots is present and its species family (GetSlotSpeciesFamily) equals E; otherwise C = $FF (E-0092)

05:6C86.name: Get2BitFieldEOfHL
05:6C86.note: E = field number: A = bits 1-0 of [HL] for field 0, bits 3-2 for 1, bits 5-4 for 2, bits 7-6 for 3 (moved down to bits 1-0) (E-0092)

05:6C02.name: SlotHasSkillWithFlagD
05:6C02.note: C = slot, D = mask: walks the slot's 8 skill numbers (every other byte of the 16 bytes at wD989 + 16 * C), loading part of each skill record into hFFC6 (LoadSkillRecordPart with wD868 = 5, wD869 = 1); returns A = hFFC6 & D for the first skill with a masked bit set, else A = 0; BC kept (E-0092)

05:5317.name: HPBandOfSlotHFFC6
05:5317.note: hFFC6 = battle slot: C = 0 when its HP >= 2/3 of its max HP, 1 when >= 1/2, 2 when >= 1/3, 3 when >= 1/4, 4 when >= 1/10, else 5 (GetBattleHP_Bank05, GetBattleMaxHP_Bank05, divisions rounded down) (E-0092)

05:6198.name: CheckWD2CCSetModeGated
05:6198.note: C = 1 when wDA53[actor] (the AI mode) is below 3; otherwise C = 0 when wD2CC is non-zero, $FF when it is zero (E-0092)

1F:5D2A.name: DrawTileRectFromWD7F1Params
1F:5D2A.note: parameters wD7F1/wD7F2 = source (high, low), wD7F3 = width, wD7F4 = rows, wD7F5/wD7F6 = BG map destination (high, low): copies each row of tiles to the BG map with interrupts off after rSTAT bit 1 clears, wrapping columns inside the 32-entry row; on CGB, when wD7F7 is 0, also zero-fills the same entries in VRAM bank 1 (attributes); the row loop is not read to its end (E-0093)

04:431F.name: DecompressGraphicsHFFC6ToHFFCA
04:431F.note: hFFC6/hFFC7 = graphics number, hFFCA/hFFCB = VRAM destination: with hFFC8 = 0 the source and bank come from a 3-byte-per-entry table at $4EAA; otherwise from the word table at $43AC with bank $7D ($7E for numbers $50 and up); then DecompressToVRAM; on CGB it goes on to the palette (not read) (E-0093)

02:5923.name: SetFollowerTargetsFromLeader
02:5923.note: the three 5-byte follower records at wFollowerRecords hold direction, X, Y, target X, target Y: record 0's target = hPlayerX/hPlayerY, record 1's target = record 0's position, record 2's target = record 1's position (E-0093)

02:5946.name: StepFollowersTowardTargets
02:5946.note: unless wC94D is non-zero, moves each of the three follower records one pixel toward its target (four pixels when wC468 bit 7 is set), X first and then Y, storing the direction moved in byte 0 (1 = X increasing, 3 = X decreasing; Y directions not read to the end) (E-0093)

05:4527.name: AnyFoeLacksStatus5Bits01
05:4527.note: C = $FF when one of the actor's three opposite slots is present with status byte 5 (wD811) & $03 clear (AnySlotLacksStatusMask), else 0 (E-0094)

05:4539.name: AnyFoeLacksStatus5Bit0And1Bit1
05:4539.note: C = $FF when one of the actor's three opposite slots is present with status byte 5 (wD811) bit 0 clear and status byte 1 (wD80D) bit 1 clear, else 0 (E-0094)

05:456B.name: AnyFoeLacksStatus5Bit1And1Bit1
05:456B.note: C = $FF when one of the actor's three opposite slots is present with status byte 5 (wD811) bit 1 clear and status byte 1 (wD80D) bit 1 clear, else 0 (E-0094)

05:46F3.name: ActorLacksStatus4Bits01
05:46F3.note: C = 0 when the actor's status byte 4 (wD810) & $03 is set, else C = $FF (the correct form of the test ActorStatus4CheckReadsAddress gets wrong) (E-0094)

05:471B.name: ActorLacksStatus1Bit2
05:471B.note: C = 0 when the actor's status byte 1 (wD80D) bit 2 is set, else C = $FF (E-0094)

05:472E.name: ActorLacksStatus1Bit3
05:472E.note: C = 0 when the actor's status byte 1 (wD80D) bit 3 is set, else C = $FF (E-0094)

05:47E5.name: AnyAllyWDA76Bits2To5NotAllSet
05:47E5.note: walks the actor's own three slots through their 7-byte wDA76 entries: C = $FF when a present slot's entry & $3C is not $3C, else 0 (E-0094)

05:6BBC.name: CompareHPWithHalfMax
05:6BBC.note: A = slot whose max HP is used, C = slot whose HP is used (callers normally pass the same slot): compares 2 x HP with the max HP (CompareHLToBC): carry set when HP is below 1/2 of max, Z when exactly 1/2; BC kept (E-0094)

05:6BCE.name: CompareHPWithQuarterMax
05:6BCE.note: A = slot whose max HP is used, C = slot whose HP is used (callers normally pass the same slot): compares 4 x HP with the max HP (CompareHLToBC): carry set when HP is below 1/4 of max, Z when exactly 1/4; BC kept (E-0094)

05:6BE1.name: CompareHPWithTenthMax
05:6BE1.note: A = slot whose max HP is used, C = slot whose HP is used (callers normally pass the same slot): compares 10 x HP with the max HP (CompareHLToBC): carry set when HP is below 1/10 of max, Z when exactly 1/10; BC kept (E-0094)

05:6F01.name: CountSlotSkills40To47
05:6F01.note: A = battle slot: counts the skills numbered $40-$47 among the slot's 8 skills (every other byte of wD989 + 16 * slot): A = the count, Z set when there are none; BC kept (E-0094)

05:4E0F.name: CheckWCFC5Not4Or5
05:4E0F.note: C = 0 when wCFC5 is 4 or 5, else C = $FF (E-0094)

36:6159.name: RollSkillDamageFromRecord
36:6159.note: picks a base and spread from the loaded skill record: wCFFB/wCFFC and wCFFD for actors in slots 4-7 when wC58A is not 1, otherwise wCFF7/wCFF8 and wCFF9; the spread goes to wD86A and RollDamageBaseToBasePlusWD86A sets the damage word; then falls into HLToWD814EntryOfWD8A5_Bank36 (E-0095)

36:618F.name: RollDamageBaseToBasePlusWD86A
36:618F.note: HL = base: wBattleDamageLo/wD873 = RandomInRange(HL, HL + wD86A); HL kept (E-0095)

36:61A6.name: GetTargetWDA72Byte0
36:61A6.note: A = byte 0 of wBattleTarget's 7-byte record at wDA72 + 7 * target (that is, wDA72 + 7 * target); DE points at it (E-0095)

36:61AB.name: GetTargetWDA72Byte1
36:61AB.note: A = byte 1 of wBattleTarget's 7-byte record at wDA72 + 7 * target (that is, wDA73 + 7 * target); DE points at it (E-0095)

36:61B0.name: GetTargetWDA72Byte2
36:61B0.note: A = byte 2 of wBattleTarget's 7-byte record at wDA72 + 7 * target (that is, wDA74 + 7 * target); DE points at it (E-0095)

36:61B5.name: GetTargetWDA72Byte3
36:61B5.note: A = byte 3 of wBattleTarget's 7-byte record at wDA72 + 7 * target (that is, wDA75 + 7 * target); DE points at it (E-0095)

36:61BA.name: GetTargetWDA72Byte4
36:61BA.note: A = byte 4 of wBattleTarget's 7-byte record at wDA72 + 7 * target (that is, wDA76 + 7 * target); DE points at it (E-0095)

36:61BF.name: GetTargetWDA72Byte5
36:61BF.note: A = byte 5 of wBattleTarget's 7-byte record at wDA72 + 7 * target (that is, wDA77 + 7 * target); DE points at it (E-0095)

36:61C4.name: GetTargetWDA72Byte6
36:61C4.note: A = byte 6 of wBattleTarget's 7-byte record at wDA72 + 7 * target (that is, wDA78 + 7 * target); DE points at it (E-0095)

36:6278.name: RollChanceByLevel_100_84_50_0
36:6278.note: A = level 0-3: success always for 0, when wC5E7 < $D8 (216/256) for 1, < $7F (127/256) for 2, never for 3; carry set = success; each roll is AdvanceRandom then wC5E7 compared with a threshold (E-0095)

36:628E.name: RollChanceByLevel_100_100_75_0
36:628E.note: A = level 0-3: success always for 0 and 1, when wC5E7 < $BF (191/256) for 2, never for 3; carry set = success; each roll is AdvanceRandom then wC5E7 compared with a threshold (E-0095)

36:629B.name: RollChanceByLevel_100_75_40_0
36:629B.note: A = level 0-3: success always for 0, when wC5E7 < $BF for 1, < $66 (102/256) for 2, never for 3; carry set = success; each roll is AdvanceRandom then wC5E7 compared with a threshold (E-0095)

36:62B1.name: RollChanceByLevelAndSide
36:62B1.note: A = level 0-3: for a target in slots 0-3 (unless wC58A = 1) success when wC5E7 < $7F, $4C, $26 for levels 0-2 (about 50%, 30%, 15%); otherwise < $BF, $7F, $3F (about 75%, 50%, 25%); never for level 3; carry set = success; each roll is AdvanceRandom then wC5E7 compared with a threshold (E-0095)

36:62DC.name: ScaleDamageByLevel_1_085_05_0
36:62DC.note: A = level 0-3: scales the damage word wBattleDamageLo/wD873 by 1 (unchanged), 85/100, 1/2 or 0 (E-0095)

36:62EF.name: ScaleDamageByLevel_1_075_04_0
36:62EF.note: A = level 0-3: scales the damage word wBattleDamageLo/wD873 by 1 (unchanged), 3/4, 0.4 or 0 (E-0095)

36:6302.name: ScaleDamageByLevel_131_116_075_03
36:6302.note: A = level 0-3: scales the damage word wBattleDamageLo/wD873 by 21/16, 37/32, 3/4 or 0.3 (E-0095)

36:6319.name: ScaleDamageByLevel_075_05_025_0
36:6319.note: A = level 0-3: scales the damage word wBattleDamageLo/wD873 by 3/4, 1/2, 1/4 or 0 (E-0095)

36:61D6.name: RollChanceByFlagsAtHL
36:61D6.note: picks the chance table by the flags at [HL]: bit 6 set uses RollChanceByLevel_100_75_40_0, else bit 7 set uses RollChanceByLevel_100_100_75_0, else RollChanceByLevel_100_84_50_0 (A = level) (E-0095)

36:620F.name: RollChanceByFlagsAtHLSided
36:620F.note: bit 7 of [HL] set uses RollChanceByLevel_100_84_50_0, otherwise RollChanceByLevelAndSide (A = level) (E-0095)

36:621C.name: ScaleDamageByFlagsAtHL
36:621C.note: bit 6 of [HL] set uses ScaleDamageByLevel_1_075_04_0, else bit 7 set uses ScaleDamageByLevel_131_116_075_03, else ScaleDamageByLevel_1_085_05_0 (A = level) (E-0095)

36:646C.name: ScaleHLBy21Over16
36:646C.note: HL += HL / 4 + HL / 16 (each shift rounds down); BC = HL / 16 (E-0095)

36:6477.name: ScaleHLBy37Over32
36:6477.note: HL += HL / 8 + HL / 32 (each shift rounds down) (E-0095)

36:7D5B.name: TargetStatus3Address
36:7D5B.note: HL = wD80F + 9 * wBattleTarget, the target's status byte 3 (E-0096)

36:66E0.name: ComputeAttackDamageWithHalvedDEF
36:66E0.note: halves the target's wBattleDEF word, runs ComputeAttackDamage (which halves DEF again, so the effective DEF is a quarter), then restores the DEF word (E-0096)

36:6232.name: ScaleDamageByFlagsAtHLAlt
36:6232.note: bit 6 of [HL] set uses ScaleDamageByLevel_075_05_025_0, else bit 7 set uses ScaleDamageByLevel_131_116_075_03, else ScaleDamageByLevel_1_075_04_0 (A = level) (E-0096)

36:65B6.name: ForceLevel4IfActorWD854Bit2
36:65B6.note: A = level: returns A unchanged when it is 3; otherwise A = 4 when bit 2 of the actor's wD854 entry (word per slot) is set, else A unchanged; BC, HL kept (E-0096)

36:5B5D.name: RollChanceVsTargetWDA72Byte5Bits23
36:5B5D.note: HL = the target's wD814 entry; level = bits 3-2 of the target's wDA72 byte 5 (GetTargetWDA72Byte5); for actions $7A, $8E and $90 success is certain when ForceLevel4IfActorWD854Bit2 returns 4, else RollChanceByFlagsAtHLSided; other actions use RollChanceByFlagsAtHL; carry = success (E-0096)

36:7D45.name: SetSlotStatus6Bit6
36:7D45.note: A = slot: sets bit 6 of its status byte 6 (wD812 + 9 * slot); HL kept (E-0096)

36:6622.name: GetBaseATKOfSlotA
36:6622.note: A = battle slot: BC = the slot's base ATK (GetBaseATK, wBattleStatResultLo/Hi) (E-0096)

36:6634.name: GetBaseDEFOfSlotA
36:6634.note: A = battle slot: BC = the slot's base DEF (GetBaseDEF); HL kept (E-0096)

36:6646.name: GetBaseAGLOfSlotA
