1D:5F2D.note: over the first wD7FF SRAM records ($A5 bytes each from sA000; wD7FF is set by LoadWD7FFFromWC7C7Table): clears wD789 and wD7BE (30 bytes each), then appends every record whose byte 0 is 1 or 2 and byte $6E is 0; wD7A9 = the list length, wD7B9 = how many in-use records had byte $6E set (E-0104)

1D:6026.name: ListRecordsInUseWithByte6ESet
1D:6026.note: over the first wD7FF SRAM records ($A5 bytes each from sA000; wD7FF is set by LoadWD7FFFromWC7C7Table): clears wD789, then appends every record whose byte 0 is 1 or 2 and byte $6E is non-zero; wD7A9 = the list length (E-0104)

1D:7AD8.name: UnpackByteAtHLTo2BitFieldsWD7F5
1D:7AD8.note: with SRAM bank wD7F2 selected, splits the byte at HL into four 2-bit fields: wD7F5 = bits 7-6, wD7F6 = bits 5-4, wD7F7 = bits 3-2, wD7F8 = bits 1-0 (E-0104)

1D:70F9.name: Pack2BitFieldsFromWD7E2
1D:70F9.note: B = (wD7E2 & 3) << 6 | (wD7E3 & 3) << 4 | (wD7E4 & 3) << 2 | (wD7E5 & 3), the opposite of unpacking a byte into four 2-bit fields (E-0104)

1D:58C8.name: DrawThreeDigitsAtScrollOffset6E
1D:58C8.note: writes the three bytes at wD7CE as digit tiles ($E0 + digit) at the BG map entry BGMapAddressAtScroll + $6E (row 3, column 14 of the view), one per byte with WaitForVRAMAccess (E-0104)

1D:6973.name: DecompressGraphicsWD7F1ToWD7F4
1D:6973.note: graphics number = the word wD7F1/wD7F2: reads its far pointer (3 bytes per entry) from Data_004_4EAA in bank $04 (ReadFarPointerAtDEInBankB) and DecompressToVRAM to the address in wD7F4/wD7F5; on CGB it continues with the palette (not read) (E-0104)

1D:65F6.name: UpdateListCursorWD7AB
1D:65F6.note: list cursor over wD7A9 entries: Up/Down move wD7AB with wrap, erase and redraw the cursor, play sound $69 and set wMenuInputResult = $FD; A draws the confirmed cursor, plays sound $69 and sets $FF; B sets $FE; with no input the cursor blinks and the result is 0 (the codes of UpdatePagedListCursor) (E-0106)

1D:62AD.name: DrawRecordListNameTiles_Bank1D
1D:62AD.note: with SRAM enabled, for each of the wC6FD record numbers in wC6FE copies the record's name (CopyRecordNameToWC8CF, C = 1) and draws it as glyph tiles at the VRAM address from Data_01D_62F9 (CopyGlyphTilesToVRAM); then disables SRAM (E-0106)

1D:75C7.name: CopyTenBytesThenSelectSRAMBank0
1D:75C7.note: copies 10 bytes from HL to DE, selecting SRAM bank 0 (rRAMB = 0) after each byte is read; HL and DE advance (E-0106)

12:7DF1.name: RemoveInventorySlotShiftDown
12:7DF1.note: hFFC6 = inventory slot: moves each wInventory byte after it down by one up to slot $17 (the last slot keeps its old value), then wC634 = $FF; nothing moves when the slot is $17 (E-0106)

15:683C.name: SubtractWD7F1AmountFromGold
15:683C.note: wGold -= the 24-bit amount wD7F3:wD7F2:wD7F1 (no floor; callers check first, for example with IsAmountInWD7F1AboveGold) (E-0106)

15:6676.name: UnpackBCDToDigitsWD7F1
15:6676.note: wD7F1 = hFFC9, then the high and low digits of hFFC8, hFFC7 and hFFC6 go to wD7F2-wD7F7 (seven digits of a packed-BCD number, most significant first); the loop that follows (C = 6) is not read (E-0106)

1E:7564.name: DrawPageOfPagesAtScrollOffset
1E:7564.note: HL = BGMapAddressAtScroll + the offset in wD7F1 (high) / wD7F2 (low): writes tile $E0 + wD7AF + 1 there and tile $E0 + wD7B0 two entries later, each through StepBGMapAddressBackOnScrollWrap and WaitForVRAMAccess (current page and page count) (E-0106)

F1:4870.name: UpdateMenuCursor_BankF1
F1:4870.note: the same instruction sequence as UpdateMenuCursor (bank $03) apart from label operands, which refer to this bank's own routines and tables; the twin's note describes the shape (E-0107)

F1:42D9.name: ShowSelectedItemDescription_BankF1
F1:42D9.note: the same instruction sequence as ShowSelectedItemDescription (bank $03) apart from label operands, which refer to this bank's own routines and tables; the twin's note describes the shape (E-0107)

05:6312.name: HPBandOfSlotHFFC6_6312
05:6312.note: the same instruction sequence as HPBandOfSlotHFFC6 (bank $05) apart from label operands, which refer to this bank's own routines and tables; the twin's note describes the shape (E-0107)

1B:665E.name: ScriptCommandEF_Run_Bank1B
1B:665E.note: the same instruction sequence as ScriptCommandEF_Run (bank $0D) apart from label operands, which refer to this bank's own routines and tables; the twin's note describes the shape (E-0107)

F0:6384.name: DrawPageOfPagesAtScrollOffset_BankF0
F0:6384.note: the same instruction sequence as DrawPageOfPagesAtScrollOffset (bank $1E) apart from label operands, which refer to this bank's own routines and tables; the twin's note describes the shape (E-0107)

A1:413F.name: RunBattleCommandEntry_BankA1
A1:413F.note: the same instruction sequence as RunBattleCommandEntry (bank $30) apart from label operands, which refer to this bank's own routines and tables; the twin's note describes the shape (E-0107)

A0:5E07.name: RunBattleSetup_BankA0
A0:5E07.note: the same instruction sequence as RunBattleSetup (bank $31) apart from label operands, which refer to this bank's own routines and tables; the twin's note describes the shape (E-0107)

3B:4AB2.name: RollChanceByLevel_100_100_75_0_Bank3B
3B:4AB2.note: the same instruction sequence as RollChanceByLevel_100_100_75_0 (bank $36) apart from label operands, which refer to this bank's own routines and tables; the twin's note describes the shape (E-0107)

7F:40CC.name: DrawMetaSpriteAt_40CC
7F:40CC.note: the same instruction sequence as DrawMetaSpriteAt (bank $7F) apart from label operands, which refer to this bank's own routines and tables; the twin's note describes the shape (E-0107)

00:11DA.name: DarkenDMGPaletteByFadeLevel
00:11DA.note: A = a DMG palette byte (four 2-bit shades): each shade + wFadeLevel, capped at 3 (black), is packed back and stored at [HL] (DarkenDMGShade and DarkenDMGShadeNext) (E-0108)

00:11F5.name: DarkenDMGShade
00:11F5.note: adds B (the level) to the 2-bit shade in A & 3, caps it at 3, ORs it into C and rotates C right by 2 (E-0108)

00:11F0.name: DarkenDMGShadeNext
00:11F0.note: rotates D right by 2 to bring the next shade down, then DarkenDMGShade (E-0108)

00:1145.name: LightenDMGPaletteByFadeLevel
00:1145.note: A = a DMG palette byte: each 2-bit shade - wFadeLevel, at least 0 (white), is packed back and stored at [HL] (LightenDMGShade and LightenDMGShadeNext) (E-0108)

00:1160.name: LightenDMGShade
00:1160.note: subtracts B (the level) from the 2-bit shade in A & 3 (at least 0), ORs it into C and rotates C right by 2 (E-0108)

00:115B.name: LightenDMGShadeNext
00:115B.note: rotates D right by 2 to bring the next shade down, then LightenDMGShade (E-0108)

00:076B.name: ClearSGBPacketBuffer
00:076B.note: zero-fills the 16 bytes of wSGBPacketBuffer; BC, HL kept (E-0108)

00:08A6.name: ClearSTATInterruptSources
00:08A6.note: rSTAT &= $07: clears the LCD-status interrupt source bits 3-6, keeping the mode and coincidence flags (E-0108)

00:07D1.name: WaitSerialTransferDone
00:07D1.note: waits until rSC bit 7 (transfer in progress) clears (E-0108)

00:1F95.name: LoadRecordThreeBytesToHFFC6
00:1F95.note: A = record, C = field offset (SRAMRecordAddress): copies three bytes from the record to hFFC6-hFFC8; HL kept (E-0108)

00:1022.name: CopySGBPacketFieldsAndSend
00:1022.note: copies 8 bytes from HL to DE, skips 2 source bytes, copies 6 more, then wSGBPacketIndex = $FF and far-calls SendSGBPacketSet (E-0108)

02:706E.name: CheckSaveData
02:706E.note: with SRAM bank 1 selected: hFFC6 = 1 when sBB00 is not the signature $55 (no save); otherwise 2 when VerifySaveBank1Checksum or VerifySaveBank3Checksum returns non-zero (damaged save), else 0 (valid); then disables SRAM (E-0109)

02:70A2.name: VerifySaveBank1Checksum
02:70A2.note: sums the SRAM bank-1 bytes from sA06F into the word DE (the loop adds several bytes per pass; the comparison at the end is not read) and returns A non-zero on a mismatch, as CheckSaveData uses it (E-0109)

02:7111.name: VerifySaveBank3Checksum
02:7111.note: sums the SRAM bank-3 bytes from sA000 into the word DE (comparison not read) and returns A non-zero on a mismatch, as CheckSaveData uses it (E-0109)

02:72B0.name: CopySaveBlocksToSRAM
02:72B0.note: with SRAM bank 1 selected, walks the list at Data_002_75F7 (word address, word length; a zero address ends it) and copies each WRAM block to SRAM from sBB01 onward (the copy loop is not read to its end) (E-0109)

02:7598.name: CopySaveBlocksToSRAMWithSum
02:7598.note: the same walk of Data_002_75F7 into SRAM from sBB01, also clearing the running sum in hFFC8/hFFC9 (accumulation not read to its end) (E-0109)

02:755E.name: SnapshotSpritesForSave
02:755E.note: wC83A = wCB7E and the $50 bytes of wSpriteSlots go to wC83B; then clears bit 1 of five object flag bytes at wC848, wC858, wC868, wC878 and wC888 (E-0109)

02:717D.name: RunSaveSteps
02:717D.note: with SRAM enabled, steps by wC8C3: on the first call (0) sets it to 1 and runs CopySaveBlocksToSRAM and three more save routines; on the second runs Func_002_71B2; afterwards sets bit 7 of wC8C3 (finished); disables SRAM each time (E-0109)

31:778E.name: ReadWordTableEntryForSlotC
31:778E.note: HL = table: HL = the word at HL + 2 * (C & 3) (falls into DerefHL_Bank31) (E-0110)

31:7797.name: DerefHL_Bank31
31:7797.note: HL = the word at HL; A = its low byte (E-0110)

31:7379.name: LoadMonsterPictureAttributesFromDE
31:7379.note: hFFC6 = C (palette number), DE = the monster id word stored at [DE], then LoadMonsterPictureAttributes (HL = BG map address from the caller); DE kept (E-0110)

31:7509.name: DrawWC2A4AndWC2B8Rects
31:7509.note: copies a 7 x 1 rectangle from wC2A4 to vBGMap0 + $10C (row 8, column 12) and a 20 x 9 rectangle from wC2B8 to vBGMap0 + $120 (row 9), both with CopyRect32StrideToVRAM (E-0110)

31:74A0.name: DrawWC278Rect12x11ToBGMapRow7
31:74A0.note: copies a 12 x 11 rectangle from wC278 (rows 32 bytes apart) to vBGMap0 + $E0 (row 7) with CopyRect32StrideToVRAM (E-0110)

31:71F5.name: ClearAttributesAndScreenBuffer_Bank31
31:71F5.note: on CGB writes 0 to the 20 x 18 visible attributes of vBGMap0 in VRAM bank 1 (rows 32 apart, WriteVRAMByteInc); then fills the $240 bytes of wScreenTileBuffer with $C3; what follows is not read (E-0110)

31:6DDD.name: ShowStringHL_Bank31
31:6DDD.note: wStringCategory = H, wStringIndex = L, then far-calls BeginStringDisplay_Bank2F (E-0110)

31:6286.name: ReturnZero_6286
31:6286.note: A = 0 (xor a, so Z set and carry clear); a two-byte handler stub (E-0110)

31:61A2.name: ReturnZero_61A2
31:61A2.note: A = 0 (xor a, so Z set and carry clear); a two-byte handler stub (E-0110)

31:7806.name: DrawSlotHPDigits
31:7806.note: C = battle slot, drawn only for the displayed side (slots 0-2 normally, 4-6 when wC58A = 1 and wC57F bit 1 is set; slots 3 and 7 never); with wC58A = 2 the bank-$A0 version is far-called instead: writes the slot's HP (wBattleHP) as decimal digit tiles (HLToDecimalDigits) into wScreenTileBuffer at the position from Data_031_7AC8 (E-0111)

31:785F.name: DrawSlotMPDigits
31:785F.note: C = battle slot, drawn only for the displayed side (slots 0-2 normally, 4-6 when wC58A = 1 and wC57F bit 1 is set; slots 3 and 7 never); with wC58A = 2 the bank-$A0 version is far-called instead: writes the slot's MP (wBattleMP) as decimal digit tiles into wScreenTileBuffer at the slot's position (E-0111)

31:77B9.name: CopySlotPanelRowToVRAM
31:77B9.note: C = battle slot, drawn only for the displayed side (slots 0-2 normally, 4-6 when wC58A = 1 and wC57F bit 1 is set; slots 3 and 7 never); with wC58A = 2 the bank-$A0 version is far-called instead: copies the slot's 5-tile panel row from wScreenTileBuffer to the same position of vBGMap0 (offset from Data_031_7ADA, WriteVRAMByteInc) (E-0111)

31:76AE.name: DrawSlotStatusMarks
31:76AE.note: C = battle slot, drawn only for the displayed side (slots 0-2 normally, 4-6 when wC58A = 1 and wC57F bit 1 is set; slots 3 and 7 never); with wC58A = 2 the bank-$A0 version is far-called instead: draws the slot's status markers from its status bytes (the per-status part is not read to its end) (E-0111)

A0:6B46.name: DrawSlotHPDigits_BankA0
A0:6B46.note: C = slot 0-2: writes the slot's HP as decimal digit tiles into wScreenTileBuffer at the position from Data_0A0_6D47 (the wC58A = 2 form of DrawSlotHPDigits) (E-0111)

A0:6B79.name: DrawSlotMPDigits_BankA0
A0:6B79.note: C = slot 0-2: writes the slot's MP as decimal digit tiles into wScreenTileBuffer at the position from Data_0A0_6D4B (the wC58A = 2 form of DrawSlotMPDigits) (E-0111)

A0:6B1E.name: CopySlotPanelRowToVRAM_BankA0
A0:6B1E.note: C = slot 0-2: copies the 5-tile panel row at Data_0A0_6D53's offset from wScreenTileBuffer to vBGMap0 (the wC58A = 2 form of CopySlotPanelRowToVRAM) (E-0111)

A0:6A45.name: DrawSlotStatusMarks_BankA0
A0:6A45.note: C = slot 0-2: when the slot is present and its status byte 0 is non-zero, calls one marker routine for each of bits 0, 1, 4, 5, 6 and 7 that is set (the zero-status path is not read) (E-0111)

A0:591A.name: WriteUnknownNamePlaceholder
A0:591A.note: writes '???' ($98 three times, the charmap '?') followed by seven $F0 bytes at HL: a 10-byte name field holding a placeholder (E-0111)

A0:6871.name: ReturnZero_6871
A0:6871.note: A = 0 (xor a); a two-byte handler stub (E-0111)

A0:4C9B.name: DrawWC2B8Rect11x9ToBGMapRow9_BankA0
A0:4C9B.note: copies an 11 x 9 rectangle from wC2B8 to vBGMap0 + $120 (row 9) with CopyRect32StrideToVRAM_BankA0 (E-0111)

A0:6BB3.name: DrawSlotLevel_BankA0
A0:6BB3.note: C = slot 0-2: writes tiles $EA, $AF (not in the charmap; probably a level mark) into wScreenTileBuffer at the position from Data_0A0_6D4F, then the value wD8B7[slot] as digits (probably the level; the digit part is not read to its end) (E-0111)

E0:47F0.name: DrawBits10OfDEAsDigit
E0:47F0.note: writes bits 1-0 of [DE] as digit tile $E0 + value (0-3) at HL (WriteVRAMByteInc) (E-0112)

E0:47EB.name: DrawBits32OfDEAsDigit
E0:47EB.note: writes bits 3-2 of [DE] as digit tile $E0 + value (0-3) at HL (WriteVRAMByteInc) (E-0112)

E0:47E6.name: DrawBits54OfDEAsDigit
E0:47E6.note: writes bits 5-4 of [DE] as digit tile $E0 + value (0-3) at HL (WriteVRAMByteInc) (E-0112)

E0:47E0.name: DrawBits76OfNextDEAsDigit
E0:47E0.note: DE += 1, then writes bits 7-6 of [DE] as digit tile $E0 + value (0-3) at HL (WriteVRAMByteInc) (E-0112)

E0:4763.name: DrawPacked2BitFieldsInRows
E0:4763.note: writes a run of 2-bit fields from [DE] onward as digit tiles with the four DrawBitsNN routines, five per row, moving HL to the next BG map row (+$1B) after each five; the end is not read (E-0112)

E0:488E.name: WriteHexDigitTile
E0:488E.note: A = 0-15: writes tile $E0 + A for 0-9, or A - 2 for 10-15, at HL (WriteVRAMByteInc) (E-0112)

E0:4870.name: DrawFourBytesAsHexRows
E0:4870.note: writes four bytes from DE as two hex digits each (WriteHexDigitTile), one byte per BG map row (HL += $1E after each) (E-0112)

E0:4863.name: DrawEightBytesAsHexColumns
E0:4863.note: DrawFourBytesAsHexRows at HL, then the next four bytes in a second column three entries to the right (E-0112)

E0:5715.name: ChooseTargetIfUnset
E0:5715.note: when the actor's wBattleTargetChoice entry is $FF (no target yet), far-calls ChooseActionTarget (E-0112)

E0:44B3.name: DrawSlotHPMPStats_BankE0
E0:44B3.note: C = slot: unless its wBattleSlotOut entry is $FF, draws its HP, max HP, MP and max MP words (Func_0E0_4593 for each) at the position from the table at $4652 (C & 3); the rest is not read (E-0112)

E0:4ABB.name: DrawHexByteAtBGMap8A
E0:4ABB.note: writes A as two hex-digit tiles (0-9 as $E0 + n, 10-15 as n - 2): the low digit at vBGMap0 + $8A, then the high digit (the second write is not read to its end) (E-0112)

E0:41E9.name: ShowSkillNumberAndName_BankE0
E0:41E9.note: writes the two nibbles of wC5F9, each plus 1, as tiles at vBGMap0 + $CA; copies string wC5F9 of category 4 (skill names) to wC130 (CopyStringHLToDE) and shows string 5 of category 8 (ShowString_Bank08) (E-0112)

3A:6650.name: SetWDA5BForPresentSlots
3A:6650.note: C = first slot, B = count, D = value: wDA5B[slot] = D for every present slot in the range (CarryUnlessWDA63SlotEmpty) (E-0113)

3A:4D2B.name: CopyVRAMRectToBuffer
3A:4D2B.note: copies rows of wD805 bytes from VRAM at HL (WaitForVRAMAccess, interrupts off per byte) to DE, C rows, the destination rows 32 bytes apart (the source-row step is not read) (E-0113)

3A:7B82.name: WriteMonstersWordToWC130
3A:7B82.note: writes the glyphs of 'Monsters' (decoded with the charmap) and $F0 to wC130 (E-0113)

3A:795D.name: CopyTargetSideNameToWC130
3A:795D.note: wD86C = wBattleTarget & 4 (the first slot of the target's side), then CopySlotNameToHL with HL = wC130 (E-0113)

3A:78EE.name: CopyActorNameToWC130
3A:78EE.note: wD86C = wBattleActor, then CopySlotNameToHL with HL = wC130 (E-0113)

3A:7908.name: CopyMappedSlotNameToWC140
3A:7908.note: far-calls Func_0A3_414F (which maps the actor to a slot in hFFC6), then copies that slot's name to wC140 (CopySlotNameToHL) (E-0113)

00:0030.name: Rst30Vector
00:0030.note: the rst $30 vector: a bare ret (unused restart) (E-0114)

00:0038.name: Rst38Vector
00:0038.note: the rst $38 vector: a bare ret (unused restart) (E-0114)

00:0048.name: StatInterruptVector
00:0048.note: the LCD STAT interrupt vector ($0048): jumps to the handler at Jump_000_256A (E-0114)

00:0058.name: SerialInterruptVector
00:0058.note: the serial-transfer interrupt vector ($0058): jumps to the handler at Jump_000_255B (E-0114)

00:0100.name: ROMEntryPoint
00:0100.note: the cartridge entry point ($0100): nop, then jp Func_000_0150 (E-0114)

00:089F.name: EnableLYCInterruptSource
00:089F.note: rSTAT |= $40: selects the LY = LYC coincidence as an LCD STAT interrupt source (E-0114)

00:0A4F.name: ReadJoypadIntoWC560
00:0A4F.note: ReadJoypadDirect, then wC561 = the old wC560 and wC560 = B (the new reading); finally rP1 = $30 (deselects both key groups) (E-0114)

00:0BA2.name: StoreAFourTimesAtHL
00:0BA2.note: stores A at HL, HL+1, HL+2, HL+3; HL += 4 (E-0114)

00:2C6A.name: ClearStringDisplayFlags
00:2C6A.note: clears bit 7 of wC52C and bit 1 of wC52B (E-0114)

00:2E72.name: ShowStringHL_Bank08
00:2E72.note: wStringCategory = H, wStringIndex = L, then far-calls BeginStringDisplay_Bank08 (E-0114)

00:3A5D.name: ClearChannelLengthBits
00:3A5D.note: [$FF00 + wDD0D + $11] &= $C0: keeps the duty bits of the current channel's length/duty register and clears its length (E-0114)

01:540D.name: WriteTileDPlusBAtHL
01:540D.note: writes tile D + B at VRAM address HL with interrupts off (WriteVRAMByte); AF kept (E-0114)

01:5417.name: WriteTileCAtHL
01:5417.note: writes tile C at VRAM address HL with interrupts off (WriteVRAMByte); AF kept (E-0114)

03:705B.name: MenuCursorAddressWC46E
03:705B.note: HL = the word at Data_003_4649 + 2 * wC46E (the cursor row's VRAM address) (E-0114)

03:7049.name: DrawMenuCursorWC46E
03:7049.note: writes the cursor tile $BB at MenuCursorAddressWC46E (E-0114)

03:7052.name: EraseMenuCursorWC46E
03:7052.note: writes the blank tile $C3 at MenuCursorAddressWC46E (E-0114)

03:74D1.name: WriteByteAAsTwoDigitTiles
03:74D1.note: ByteAToDecimalDigits, then WriteTwoDigitTilesFromWC8C1 at DE (leading zero blank); DE kept across the conversion (E-0114)

03:775A.name: LoadScreenBlock28
03:775A.note: copies screen block $28 into the tile buffer (CopyBlockToTileBuffer) (E-0114)

03:7763.name: LoadScreenBlock2D
03:7763.note: copies screen block $2D into the tile buffer (E-0114)

03:7791.name: LoadScreenBlock2B
03:7791.note: copies screen block $2B into the tile buffer (E-0114)

05:41EB.name: AnyFoeLacksStatus2Mask22
05:41EB.note: C = $FF when one of the actor's three opposite slots is present with status byte 2 (wD80E) & $22 clear (AnySlotLacksStatusMask), else 0 (E-0114)

05:4499.name: AnyFoeLacksStatus0Bit4
05:4499.note: C = $FF when one of the actor's three opposite slots is present with status byte 0 bit 4 clear (AnySlotLacksStatusMask), else 0 (E-0114)

05:5029.name: MultiplyHLByAPercent
05:5029.note: HL = HL * A / 100 (24-bit intermediate: Multiply8By16 then Divide24ByA), A = the remainder (E-0114)

05:6141.name: TestSlotStatus1Bit6
05:6141.note: C = slot: Z clear when bit 6 of its status byte 1 (wD80D) is set; HL points at the byte (E-0114)

05:6BF8.name: CompareSlotHPWith1
05:6BF8.note: A = slot: returns NZ when its HP (GetBattleHP_Bank05) is 256 or more; otherwise compares the low byte with 1: Z when HP = 1, carry when HP = 0 (E-0114)

05:702D.name: TestWCFEF
05:702D.note: A = wCFEF, Z set when it is zero (E-0114)

07:512B.name: ShowStringHL_Bank07
07:512B.note: wStringCategory = H, wStringIndex = L, then far-calls BeginStringDisplay_Bank07 (E-0114)

07:65F1.name: InitWD06ABlock
07:65F1.note: wD06A = 6 and the three bytes after it = 0 (E-0114)

0A:5593.name: JumpToWordAtHL_Bank0A
0A:5593.note: HL = the word at HL, then jp hl (E-0114)

0E:5C09.name: StoreBCAAtHL
0E:5C09.note: stores B, C and A at HL onward; HL += 3; AF kept (E-0114)

0E:5E1D.name: LoadWD01AByteWD7F4
0E:5E1D.note: wD7F5 = the byte at wD01A + wD7F4 (E-0114)

15:68F3.name: SetBitInFieldAtWD7F3
15:68F3.note: TestBitInFieldAtWD7F3, then ORs its mask into the byte, setting bit wD7F1/wD7F2 of the field at wD7F3/wD7F4 (E-0114)

16:58F6.name: StoreCToRecordField

16:68F0.name: ShowStringBCAtTileRowWD868

16:6BE0.name: InitSlotFromRecordFlags
16:6BE0.note: HL = a record flag byte, C = battle slot: unless bit 7 is set, marks the slot present (wBattleSlotOut = 0), clears its status byte 0 and sets status bit 0 when flag bit 2 is set and status bit 5 when flag bit 0 is set (E-0118)

16:70C6.name: SetRecordState2
16:70C6.note: A = record: sets its byte 0 (state) to 2 in SRAM bank 0 (SRAMRecordAddress with C = 0) (E-0118)

19:4537.name: ScaleHLToEightTenths_Bank19
19:4537.note: HL = (HL * 8) / 10 with 16-bit arithmetic (the multiply can overflow above 8191); BC and DE kept (E-0118)

19:4632.name: IncrementTableByteCappedAt3
19:4632.note: increments the byte at HL + the word hFFC6/hFFC7 unless it is already 3 or more (E-0118)

19:489D.name: StoreRandomByte80ToFFAtHL
19:489D.note: NextTableByte, then stores (wC5E7 & $7F) + $80 at HL; HL += 1 (E-0118)

1B:4362.name: ClearSoundChannelSlots
1B:4362.note: zeroes the first two bytes of each of six $20-byte sound channel slots from wSoundChannelSlots (E-0118)

1B:53AF.name: LoadPalette0FromData53C6
1B:53AF.note: on CGB copies the 8-byte palette Data_01B_53C6 into wBGPaletteBuffer and sets wC526 = $7F (E-0118)

1B:61BD.name: WriteTileBAtBGMap20FPlusWD785
1B:61BD.note: writes B at vBGMap0 + $20F + wD785 (WaitForVRAMAccess, interrupts off), then wD783 += 1 (E-0118)

1C:5F26.name: ReadF2FarPointerForWD7FB
1C:5F26.note: HL and B = the 3-byte far pointer entry wD7FB of Data_0F2_5643 in bank $F2 (ReadFarPointerAtDEInBankB); DE kept (E-0118)

1C:68DF.name: LoadWD7F1PointerForWD7FB
1C:68DF.note: HL = wD7F1/wD7F2 = the word at Data_01C_6158 + 2 * wD7FB (E-0118)

1D:6D07.name: UploadTilesFromData6D20
1D:6D07.note: copies tiles from Data_01D_6D20: two to vTiles2 + $6E0 and three to vTiles2 + $7C0 (CopyTileBytesToVRAM_Bank1D) (E-0118)

1E:5C37.name: ClearTileAreasAndIncWD782
1E:5C37.note: clears tile areas with FillTilesBxC (12 x 1 at vTiles1 + $240, 15 x 1 at + $500, 5 x 1 at + $700, 2 x 1 at + $4E0), then wD782 += 1 (E-0118)

1E:7778.name: BlankTwoTableEntries788A
1E:7778.note: stores tile $C3 at the addresses in entries 0 and 1 of the table at $788A (StoreBAtWordTableEntry_Bank1E) (E-0118)

1E:6D0F.name: DrawRect6x6From651BAtScroll41
1E:6D0F.note: draws a 6 x 6 tile rectangle from $651B at BGMapAddressAtScroll + $41 (DrawTileRectAtHLFromDE_Bank1E, attributes cleared) (E-0118)

30:4D25.name: ActorActionDataWord
30:4D25.note: BC = the word at Data_030_4D34 + 2 * the actor's chosen action (ActorActionChoiceAddress) (E-0118)

31:48C3.name: SetFollowersToPlayer
31:48C3.note: copies hPlayerFacing to the three follower directions and hPlayerX/hPlayerY to the three follower positions (the facing-preserving form of ResetFollowersToPlayer) (E-0118)

31:64CE.name: FillFiveC3AtHL
31:64CE.note: stores tile $C3 in the five bytes from HL; HL kept (E-0118)

32:5804.name: LoadActorChosenActionRecord
32:5804.note: wBattleActionId = wRecordBuffer = the actor's chosen action (wBattleActionChoice), wCFED = 0, then far-calls LoadSkillRecord (E-0118)

36:5A7A.name: DamageEightyPercentOfTargetHPScaled
36:5A7A.note: damage = the target's HP * 8 / 10 + 1 (ScaleHLTo80Percent_Bank36), then ScaleDamageByFlagsAtHL with level = bits 1-0 of the target's wDA72 byte 3 (E-0118)

36:6451.name: ScaleDamageBy3Over2
36:6451.note: the damage word = ScaleHLBy3Over2 of itself (x 1.5) (E-0118)

36:6482.name: ScaleHLBy29Over32
36:6482.note: HL = HL/2 + HL/4 + HL/8 + HL/32 (each rounded down) (E-0118)

36:7D13.name: HalveDamageIfTargetStatus2Bit2
36:7D13.note: when the target's status byte 2 (wD80E) bit 2 is set, the damage word is halved (E-0118)

39:71D4.name: TestSlotStatus2Bit3OrStatus5Bits67
39:71D4.note: C = slot: NZ when its status byte 2 bit 3 is set; otherwise A = status byte 5 & $C0 (Z when clear) (E-0118)

3A:52A4.name: DecompressGraphicsAToTiles0
3A:52A4.note: A = entry: decompresses the stream named by the 3-byte far pointer at Data_03A_52B9 + 3 * A to vTiles0 (DecompressToVRAM) (E-0118)

3A:63F7.name: SlotPresentWithStatus0Bit6
3A:63F7.note: C = slot: carry set when the slot is present and its status byte 0 bit 6 is set, else carry clear (E-0118)

3A:6D76.name: ShowActionBattleTextFrom6DAA
3A:6D76.note: D = Data_03A_6DAA[wBattleActionId]; returns at once when it is $FF; for action $CF first runs Func_03A_6D91; then ShowBattleText (E-0118)

3A:7715.name: ShowSpecialActionMessage
3A:7715.note: CopyActorNameToWC130 and CopyMappedSlotNameToWC140, then shows string Data_03A_7738[wBattleActionId - $D0] of category 0 (BeginStringDisplay_Bank2F); used for the $D0+ special actions (E-0118)

73:49C5.name: CopyItemStringToWC152
73:49C5.note: wScriptParam0 = hFFC8; copies string hFFC8 + $28 of category 5 (item names) to wC152 (CopyStringToBuffer_Bank09) (E-0118)

73:6B1F.name: WarpToMap41
73:6B1F.note: hMapId = $41, hMapScreenX/Y = 0/1, wC8C8/wC8C9 = $70/$30, wC8C6 = 1, then ScriptStartFadeAndAdvanceStep and sets story flag $6F (E-0118)

A0:4378.name: IncrementTableByteCappedAt3_BankA0
A0:4378.note: increments the byte at HL + the word hFFC6/hFFC7 unless it is already 3 or more (the bank-$A0 copy of IncrementTableByteCappedAt3) (E-0118)

A0:4900.name: BackupBattlerRecords0And1
A0:4900.note: copies battler records 0 and 1 ($4E bytes each, wBattlerRecords and wD123) to wD1BF and wD20D (E-0118)

A0:4CD4.name: DrawWC2A4AndWC2B8Rects_BankA0
A0:4CD4.note: copies 7 x 1 from wC2A4 to vBGMap0 + $10C and 20 x 9 from wC2B8 to vBGMap0 + $120 (CopyRect32StrideToVRAM_BankA0) (E-0118)

A0:69A1.name: SetWDA43AndWDA4BForWCFD4_BankA0
A0:69A1.note: A = value: stores A in wDA43[wCFD4], and also in wDA4B[wCFD4] unless A is 3 (E-0118)

31:63CD.name: SetWDA43AndWDA4BForWCFD4
31:63CD.note: A = value: stores A in wDA43[wCFD4], and also in wDA4B[wCFD4] unless A is 3 (E-0118)

A1:47C5.name: SetMapScreenFromAAndCenterPlayer
A1:47C5.note: hMapScreenX = A >> 4, hMapScreenY = A & $0F, hPlayerX = hPlayerY = $40 (E-0118)

A1:4A77.name: LoadMapPositionFromHL
A1:4A77.note: hMapScreenX/Y = the nibbles of [HL]; hPlayerX = [HL + 1] & $F0, hPlayerY = ([HL + 1] & $0F) << 4 (E-0118)

A1:4A91.name: StoreHFFCBValuesToWC945
A1:4A91.note: wC945 = hFFCB, wC946 = hFFCD, wC947 = hFFCC, wC948 = hFFCE (E-0118)

A1:5639.name: DrawMetaSpriteSet08
A1:5639.note: DrawMetaSprite with set $08, sub-index 0, no tile offset or attribute change (origin high bytes 0) (E-0118)

A1:56DC.name: DrawMetaSpriteSet26
A1:56DC.note: DrawMetaSprite with set $26, sub-index 0, tile offset $10, attribute XOR $01 (origin high bytes 0) (E-0118)

A1:5898.name: EnterGameMode1WithDefaultPalettes
A1:5898.note: wC5E0 = 3, wDataBankSave = $40, far-calls Func_002_4628, sets the default DMG palette bytes ($D2, $D2, $E2) and wGameMode = 1 (E-0118)

E0:45EE.name: WordAtDEToPackedBCD
E0:45EE.note: wC8C0/wC8C1 = the word at DE, wC8C2 = 0, then Number24ToPackedBCD; BC, HL kept (E-0118)

E0:4F86.name: DrawFourTileStripForA
E0:4F86.note: copies a 4 x 1 tile strip from bank $E0 (address from the word table at $4F9E + 2 * A) to vBGMap0 + $27 (CopyRectFromBankToVRAM) (E-0118)

E0:559E.name: RunEffectTestEntryA
E0:559E.note: loads wBattleActor, wBattleTarget, wBattleActionId and wDAD3 from the 4-byte entry A of the table at $55FB, then far-calls SelectEffectByWDAD3Flags (a test or debug entry list) (E-0118)

E0:5992.name: DisplayedSlotOfActor
E0:5992.note: A = wBattleActor, with bit 2 flipped when wC58A = 1 and wC57F bit 1 is set (the side swap of the battle panels) (E-0118)

E2:67A5.name: MaxNegativeScoreWhenWD2CCBit0
E2:67A5.note: C = (wD2CC & 1) ^ 1 and returns when non-zero; when bit 0 is set: wDA6E = 0, wDA70/wDA71 = $FFFF, C = 0 (E-0118)

F0:6214.name: RestoreSpriteStateClearCount_BankF0
F0:6214.note: hFFB9 = wD7BC, hFFBA = $80, hFF8D = wD7BA, wSpriteSlotCount = 0 (unlike RestoreSpriteStateFromWD7BA, the count is cleared rather than restored) (E-0118)

F0:6262.name: DrawRect6x6From651BAtScroll41_BankF0
F0:6262.note: draws a 6 x 6 tile rectangle from Data_0F0_651B at BGMapAddressAtScroll + $41 (DrawTileRectAtHLFromDE_BankF0) (E-0118)

F0:7097.name: RandomModulo29_BankF0
F0:7097.note: NextTableByte; L = wC5E7, H = (wC5E7 rotated left through carry) & B; returns A = HL mod $29 (E-0118)

37:5EE7.name: StoreSpeciesFamilyAtHL
37:5EE7.note: LoadSpeciesRecord (id already in wSpeciesIdLo/Hi), then stores its family at HL; HL += 1, DE += 1 (E-0118)

37:5895.name: UploadTilesFromData58AE
37:5895.note: copies tiles from Data_037_58AE: two to vTiles2 + $6E0 and three to vTiles2 + $7C0 (CopyTileBytesToVRAM_Bank37) (E-0118)

F1:573E.name: UploadTilesFromData5757_BankF1
F1:573E.note: copies tiles from Data_0F1_5757: two to vTiles2 + $6E0 and three to vTiles2 + $7C0 (E-0118)

32:51F9.name: CheckSkillMPCost
32:51F9.note: for a skill action (wBattleActionId outside $D0-$E3) the cost is byte 0 of the record in wRecordBufferData, copied to hFFC8. The actor's MP minus the cost is computed in HL; a negative result returns with D = 1 (not enough MP) and carry clear. Equal MP and cost succeeds (D = 0, carry set). The MP is not written here (E-0048)

32:59DF.name: ApplyDamageToTarget
32:59DF.note: target slot wBattleTarget (wD8A5): when wDAC1's top two bits are not 00 and not 01, wBattleHP[target] -= the 16-bit damage in wD872/wD873 and is clamped at 0 (a result below zero also decrements wCFCB and clears wCFCD); then sets bits 0, 1 and 2 of the target's wD095 flags

32:5B12.name: DefeatTarget
32:5B12.note: target slot wBattleTarget: re-derives its stats (Func_032_5C3F, Func_032_5B94, Func_032_5BE8 clear 'buff' bits), sets wBattleSlotOut[target] = 1, wBattleHP[target] = 0 and clears the target's 9-byte status record (wD80C + 9 * slot)

32:5C3F.name: RecomputeTargetMaxHPAndMP
32:5C3F.note: when bits 4-5 of the target's status byte (wD80D + 9 * slot) are set: stores GetBaseHP and GetBaseMP of the target in wBattleMaxHP and wBattleMaxMP and lowers the current values to the new maximum

36:4001.name: RunBattleResolveStep
36:4001.note: jumps through a 16-entry table indexed by wBattleResolveStep (wCFCB): one step of resolving a battle action; the steps advance wBattleResolveStep and use wBattleSubStep (wCFCC) and wBattleSubStep2 (wCFCD) for nested state

00:3F04.name: DivideHLByBC
00:3F04.note: HL = HL / BC (quotient), BC = HL mod BC; clobbers A, DE

00:3ED4.name: AdvanceRandom
00:3ED4.note: when wC58A is 0 calls NextTableByte (wC5E8 = index, wC5E7 = table byte); in link mode runs the same step on the synchronised copy in wC5BA/wC5BB

00:3E98.name: RandomInRange
00:3E98.note: HL = minimum, BC = maximum: returns DE = minimum + (random mod (maximum - minimum + 1)), the random value being wC5E8:wC5E7 after AdvanceRandom; DE = HL when the two are equal (73 call sites)

36:5025.name: ComputeBasicDamage
36:5025.note: the damage formula: HL = the acting slot's value from the array at wD8FF (Func_036_7E2E), BC = the value to compare with, set by the caller. If HL <= BC the damage is RandomInRange(0, 1). Otherwise, with half = (HL - BC) / 2: when HL / 16 >= half the damage is RandomInRange(0, HL / 16); else it is half + RandomInRange(-(half / 16), half / 16) + RandomInRange(-1, 1). The 16-bit result goes to wBattleDamageLo/Hi. The divisors are 16, not 4: ShiftHLRight4 falls through two more shifts (corrected in E-0064)

36:7E2E.name: GetBattleATK
36:7E2E.note: A = battle slot: HL = the word for that slot in the array at wD8FF (Func_036_7E5B)

36:7E33.name: GetBattleDEF
36:7E33.note: A = battle slot: HL = the word for that slot in the array at wD90F (Func_036_7E5B)

36:7E38.name: GetBattleMaxHP
36:7E38.note: A = battle slot: HL = the word for that slot in the array at wBattleMaxHP (Func_036_7E5B)

36:7E3D.name: GetBattleMaxMP
36:7E3D.note: A = battle slot: HL = the word for that slot in the array at wBattleMaxMP (Func_036_7E5B)

36:7E42.name: GetBattleHP
36:7E42.note: A = battle slot: HL = the word for that slot in the array at wBattleHP (Func_036_7E5B)

36:7E47.name: GetBattleMP
36:7E47.note: A = battle slot: HL = the word for that slot in the array at wBattleMP (Func_036_7E5B)

36:7E5B.name: ReadBattleWordFromArray
36:7E5B.note: HL = array base, A = slot: HL = the 16-bit word at HL + 2 * A

31:40D6.name: BattlePhase0
31:40D6.note: wBattlePhase = 0: the start of the battle (E-0044)

31:43B2.name: BattlePhaseFight
31:43B2.note: wBattlePhase = 1: the fight; steps: 1 set-up, 2 command entry, 3 executing the actions (E-0044)

31:43E6.name: BattlePhaseEnd
31:43E6.note: wBattlePhase = 2: after the fight; steps 0-9 (result message, rewards, recruiting) (E-0044)

31:4B10.name: RunBattleSetup
31:4B10.note: battle fight step 1: one sub-step per wBattleSubPhase (13 cases, 0-12 observed in the first battle) that builds the battle screen and loads the combatants

30:4001.name: RunBattleCommandEntry
30:4001.note: battle fight step 2: returns while a message is being drawn (wC52B); otherwise one of 7 sub-steps by wBattleSubPhase; case 0 loads the slots' personality bytes (wSlotPersonality*), the command menu loop follows

3A:6157.name: RunBattleActions
3A:6157.note: battle fight step 3: returns while a message is being drawn; in link mode calls Func_03A_4ADB; otherwise one of 6 sub-steps by wBattleSubPhase, which execute the chosen actions through RunBattleResolveStep

3A:68C9.name: RunBattleStep4
3A:68C9.note: battle fight step 4: the same prologue as RunBattleActions, then its own sub-steps (not seen in the first battle)

36:4806.name: ResolveStepDamageMessage
36:4806.note: resolve step $0A: advances wBattleResolveStep and, for the actor or target side chosen by wDAC0 bit 4, stores wDAC2 or wDAC3 in wC0A0 and calls Func_036_4991 / Func_036_4A38; the first fight showed the battle text 'took N damage!' (bank $2F, category 1, index 53) at this step

36:4901.name: ResolveStepDefeat
36:4901.note: resolve step $0D: runs the defeat sequence Func_032_5A3A (RunDefeatSequence); the first fight showed 'was defeated!' (category 1, index 139) at this step

32:5A3A.name: RunDefeatSequence
32:5A3A.note: three sub-steps by wBattleSubStep2: 0 lowers a counter (wDA5B + target by 5) and calls DefeatTarget, 1 runs Func_032_5AB3, 2 advances wBattleResolveStep, sets bit 2 of the target's wD095 flags and starts the defeat message (Func_03A_7193)

03:4692.name: PauseMenu_Main
03:4692.note: GameMode2_Update, wModeState 0: the main pause menu: PLAN (Keys, Plan, Text Speed, Re-Order, Info, Journal) and, for the first monster, INFO with its level, ATK, DEF, AGL, INT, WLD, HP and MP (E-0046)

03:5274.name: PauseMenu_Items
03:5274.note: GameMode2_Update, wModeState 1: the ITEM list ('No items' at the start of a game) (E-0046)

03:5E89.name: PauseMenu_Skills
03:5E89.note: GameMode2_Update, wModeState 2: the SKILLS list ('No skills' at the start) (E-0046)

03:6A9D.name: PauseMenu_State3
03:6A9D.note: GameMode2_Update, wModeState 3: an item list screen (state 3) (E-0046)

03:402F.name: PauseMenu_State4
03:402F.note: GameMode2_Update, wModeState 4: hands over to Func_0F1_4001 (state 4) (E-0046)
